summary: Slightly epic Bird Song in first set. Jerry sounds out of it in Terrapin. Great end to Wharf Rat. Overall not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Good long Let It Grow to end first set. Samson > Drums? Feels like a by-the-numbers show though. Is it an 84 thing?

author: maximinus
summary: Very decent HSF that goes straight into Playin', ruined by Don't Need Love. Very good Wharf Rat > Stones > NFA

author: maximinus
summary: Bob loses his vioice during HIAB; Jerry sounds doped up. 45 min first set! Only a Fool is truly dreadful.

author: maximinus
summary: Moderate. Shows are less surprising than 83. They miss "flow". Bob's fight with his voice is still present.

author: maximinus
summary: Another long Scarlet Fire. Almost 60 mins pre-drums, but then another Brent song. Meaty Morning Dew.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice Playin' jam for 10 minutes but nothing else about the show stands out. Bit of yawn, with low energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Why does Brent insist on doing a number pre-drums? Terrapin has a jam. Nothing stand out in all of 84 so far.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent Drums > Space. Lacks energy post drums (or is pretty mellow). Throwing Stones had a bit of a crash.

author: maximinus
summary: Low speed first set; 84 so far seems low energy. Touch is all over the place. Decent space. Second set had variety.

author: maximinus
summary: Another good space. In some ways, nearly a 4, but infected with that lack of energy. China Rider is a weird one.

author: maximinus
summary: Nearly fell asleep at the start. Jerry out of it. Space > Other One is decent. Jerry's voice for Dew is very froggy.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent has a ring modulator. Short first set. Ragged as usual now. From Playin' onwards is pretty decent.

author: maximinus
summary: More energy than recent shows. Unfortunate Don't Need Love after nice He's Gone jam. Good space, as is usual now.

author: maximinus
summary: Slightly more energy. Scarlet > Touch second time still didn't work. Rest of set was pretty ho-hum.

author: maximinus
summary: Summer 84 is definitly better than spring. Let It Grow into drums is the highlight, but still lacks excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Awesome 2nd set setlist. Horrible mess going into first Fantasy. Seemed to be a lot of wasted potential.

author: maximinus
summary: Encore with Rick Danko. Long, decent Scarlet Fire at the start of the second set failed to carry over.

author: maximinus
summary: 84 just seems to lack surprise. Junkie Jerry mostly fails to show. Weird clapping out of space from audience.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry hints Dancin' about 15 times. Excellent Minglewood. Playin' > China is great, and post drums retains energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Casey Jones opener! He's Gone is best jam of the year so far. Even keeps the action going post drums. Best of '84.

author: maximinus
summary: Good from the start. Long LiG to finish first set. Help > Slip! WDWDIITR a mess. Space > Dew! Solid show.

author: maximinus
summary: Rough aud for first set. Scarlet > Touch not a hit. Rest of show was normal 84, lacked some of the recent highs.

author: maximinus
summary: On a tennis court. Excellent pre-drums Shakdown > Playing > Terrapin. Post drums tails a bit. Another 'best 84'!

author: maximinus
summary: Interesting He's Gone jam for the last few minutes. Rest of the show is "nothing bad", but nothing special either.

author: maximinus
summary: Scarlet > Touch > Fire best so far, before Don't Need Love appears pre-drums. Post drums is less exciting.

author: maximinus
summary: Weird humming in FOTD. Help > Slip and He's Gone had stuff to offer. The latter was for the death of a fan.

author: maximinus
summary: 2 songs take up last 28 mins of first set. Best Mr Fantasy so far. Around & Around is a total train wreck.

author: maximinus
summary: Pre-drums had an interesting Playing > China Doll. First real Lovelight for ages. But generally pretty average.

author: maximinus
summary: Dark star encore! Rest of show is middling (though good SQ) quality. Dark Star though is good and worth a listen.

author: maximinus
summary: Some great Phil here. Pretty mellow throughout, although it meanders into forgettable territory sometimes.

author: maximinus
summary: First set is ok, but second is pretty decent. Jerry stays for Don't Need Love; Double encore. Phil speaks!

author: maximinus
summary: Finally the Brent song is not pre-drums. Competent throughout, sounded nice but really lacked excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Dancin' is the new opener. Jerry's voice a little better recently. Nice transition from space to Dew. Solid.

author: maximinus
summary: Long China > Rider (14 mins). Double intro of Sugar Mag. This is better than spring. Jerry says a word!

author: maximinus
summary: Aside from a jammy China Doll, this show has no stand-outs, and the sound quality is only so-so. Missable.

author: maximinus
summary: Jack Straw in the 2nd set? Really nice LiG. Unusual set-list. Post drums loses the excitement a little.

author: maximinus
summary: 15 min Shakedown to start! Spaciest Playin' for years, with feedback before drums. Dodgy post drums though.

author: maximinus
summary: Jack-A-Roe for Phil? Gets serious after Don't Need Love. Great Uncle John's. Sound quality dips in second set.

author: maximinus
summary: First set Miracle. 20 minute Eyes! Vocal effects OTT in Throwing Stones (which has first (?) standard chords in jam).

author: maximinus
summary: Slighty perkier first set than usual. Second set Scarlet > Fire > Playin' is 50 minutes long! Samey jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Another "quite good" first set. Long Terrapin. Slightly rushed post drums. Whistle for Truckin is awful loud.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Stranger opener. Actually has a nice set-list but lacks unusual elements. Nice digital effects in space.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice Smokestack into a short jam and a very short drums. Post drums is by the numbers. Lovelight back in the mix.

author: maximinus
summary: Wang Dang Doogle in 2nd set. Don't Need Love pre-drums. Brent's Truckin' intro kills me. GDTRFB intro train wreck.

author: maximinus
summary: Short but sweet first set. Mixed dipped in second set but not bad. Crowd try NFA chant but get it wrong.

author: maximinus
summary: Another short first set. Slips to slightly ropey aud for much of the second set. Too much delay in the space(!).

author: maximinus
summary: Matt Kelly and "Ain't Superstitous" are nice. Great bird noises in space. Definitly needs some more excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Short, iffy first set. H>S>F is messy. Wharf Rat pre-drums? Good Lovin very messy. Chaotic everywhere, underwhelming.

author: maximinus
summary: Worst first set for a long long time. Not 1 normal song pre-drums! Embarrassing, slighty better post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Mercifully better than the previous show. First Tons Of Steel and (bad) Day Tripper. Nothing stands out.

author: maximinus
summary: Playin' > Drums > Space is 45 minutes long! Easily the best Playin' of 1984. Rest is quite pedestrian though.

author: maximinus
summary: Crazy Shakedown opener. Throwing Stones jam is now complete. Show is out the door like a rocket, eases off later on.

author: maximinus
summary: Mixed up setlist. Up and down all over the place. GDTRFB into drums? Needed more stability (and more jams, of course).

author: maximinus
summary: Flanger on some vocals. Split Women / Aiko / Women, but it lacks any fizz. Not wrong, but little to salvage that shines.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob's voice is shot. Day Tripper is terrible. Start of second set is ok, but the fizzle dies early. Bob speaks Chinese.

author: maximinus
summary: Voices much better. Features a really good space / Twilight Zone exploration. Very little jaming outside this though.

author: maximinus
summary: Not a great aud. Minor MLB jam out of Smokestack pre-drums, but everything else a little lazy and lacking in bite.

author: maximinus
summary: Really short show. Playin' was long but didn't go anywhere interesting. No real direction after the second song.

author: maximinus
summary: Hot Deal to close enjoyable first set. Estimated solo was rocking. Second set was enjoyable, lacked killer touch.

author: maximinus
summary: Arrives in a hot swirl of dolby and warble. Best first set for a long time. Nice Playin', and a decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: Great tape for audience reactions. Another Scarlet > Hell. Decent space. Not bad, previous night was better though.

author: maximinus
summary: Another up-tempo first set. Second set was solid but rather flat throughout. Nice, but really needed more nasty.

author: maximinus
summary: Pre drums had a decent setlist that was well executed, but it lacked an edge, or some fizz. Post drums getting shorter.

author: maximinus
summary: First Phil song since 1974 (?). Half Step is back. Most of the show is pretty rushed. Total car crash Touch encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Truckin' opener! Good first set. Wierd LLR jam into drums. Better than last year, but not consistent over the whole show.

author: maximinus
summary: Solitary Supplication jam in first set. Weird second set setlist pre-drums. Quite good energy but low on jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Seems stuck in the same groove. First set was anonymous. Unexpected post-drums playing saves the day a little. Not great.

author: maximinus
summary: Similar to the previous night - consistency in areas you want inconsistency. Phil sings again. Weird end to NFA.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set Terrapin open has promise but then it devolves to strict 10 minute songs; common in this era. So-So.

author: maximinus
summary: Crazy Fingers started in double time! Pretty rocking GDTRFB into drums. 85 is messing with setlists, doesn't always work.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's voice is pretty bad tonight. 4 songs before drums not too bad tonight, but lack gusto. Energy better after drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Short but decent first set, with good Bird Song. Second set setlists weirder, but not always better. Post drums not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's voice is getting worse! Strange but not bad first set. Nothing in second set runs over time, except maybe Lovelight.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent but short Playin' jam. A bit better than previous shows (even the Truckin' was decent). Weird start to Sat Night.

author: maximinus
summary: Definitly getting better but not getting there yet. Decent space, but lacked intensity outside this. Not bad though.

author: maximinus
summary: Stunning board. Very tight and enjoyable first set. Second set is pleasent and lacks adventure. Seques are nice though.

author: maximinus
summary: Another good first set. Triple Playin' jam in second set, which has a great flow. Nearly a 4, but lacks something.

author: maximinus
summary: 20th anniversary shows. Nice to see Stagger Lee back. Unusual Dew to start second set but lacked much of musical interest.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's voice better than the spring. These 84 shows have some strange songs but lack flow in between them. Awesome encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Solid but unsurprising first set. First Cryptical for ages doesn't do anyhting special. First MIDI space is interesting.

author: maximinus
summary: The score is for the decent Estimated > Eyes pre drums; although the transition ionto GDTRFB was also decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Nothing special in this show. New Half-Step is too fast and there is no jamming in the second set. Anonymous.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob: "The raffle winner gets to hold the rhythm section hostage". This show has too many short songs in both sets.

author: maximinus
summary: Pretty decent attempt at a Playin' jam, though it failed to really space out. Too many short songs all over again.

author: maximinus
summary: Weird but decent first set. Great Stranger > Eyes transition. Unfortunatly, This seems the year of the ripcord. Good end.

author: maximinus
summary: Finally, a second set with some lengthy songs. Great MNS. Bit less bitty than the last few shows but still a bit average.

author: maximinus
summary: First MIDI from Brent in CC Rider? Decent Shakedown, but not the best. New effects in space, decent Stella Blue. Nearly a 4.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent setlist could not hide the lack of exploration. 1985 seems more professional but less on the ragged edge.

author: maximinus
summary: Quite short for both sets. Terrapin before drums is the highlight at 13 minutes long. Lovely car crash in Brokedown Palace.

author: maximinus
summary: Bizarre Sat. Night > Fire opener. Again in 1985 the changes are more in the setlist than in the music. Nasty static on SBD.

author: maximinus
summary: Eyes managed to sneak over the 10 minute line. End of drums and into space was good (although drums cut). Short on improv.

author: maximinus
summary: Infamous Boreal Ridge show. PA has many issues. Car crash HIAB is great. Not entirely dreadful, but not a great show.

author: maximinus
summary: Much less issues than the previous show. Quite "clean"; practically no adventure at all. Nice Good Lovin and Dew though.

author: maximinus
summary: The best audio is a pretty windy aud unfortunatly. Highlights were the LiG, Estimated and the encore. Nothing exceptional.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent energy opener. Killer bass in Uncle (!). Great Playin' and an averted Don't Need Love. Show could not sustain itself.

author: maximinus
summary: Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical in 11 minutes; sad. Both songs have slipped over the years. No particular highlights.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusually un-modern (for '85) setlist. Car crash Brokedown Palace encore. Mostly nicely done, except for no surprises at all.

author: maximinus
summary: Only 2 hours of music - including Healy's burp! Are they saving themselves for the next night? Nothing unusual, tired in places.

author: maximinus
summary: Opens with Bob madness. Very unusual Sat night to close 1st set. Decent overall second set. Still can't climb to a 4 though.

author: maximinus
summary: Awful car-crash Brent tune before drums. Almost got jammed, it went so haywire. Rest is normal 85, and speedy after drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Promised land in middle of first set? Second set is transparently without jamming. Space was not bad. Lacks adventure.

author: maximinus
summary: Above average setlist. Last H>S>F for a few years. About as good as 85 goes; nothing particularly standout, but well played.

author: maximinus
summary: Around > D/S > US Blues? A very strange show with regard to setlists, and decent for it. Super short post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Deal opener? Dew opener? Not bad up until the car crash Sugar Mag. Better than others of this era, but had more potential.

author: maximinus
summary: Gimme Some Lovin' opener. Brent song pre drums kills the mood. Post drums was decent, overall lacks in excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Scarlet > Touch again. This one really floated over me, although none of it was especially bad; a normal 1985 complaint.

author: maximinus
summary: Lost Sailor > Saint eats up jam time from second set. Good Crazy Fingers into long 9 minutes jam. Rest as expected.

author: maximinus
summary: Opens with Space > Werewolves! Short, but probably the best second set of 1985 so far. 2nd set has a great setlist.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set leads to 3 Jerry ballads pre drums. Sailor Saint split over drums. Unusual song choice to set 2 as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Pretty decent first set with nice Let It Grow. Second set has a great setlist. Best Dew for a long time. Decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: It's not a bad show, but the setlist looks so 1977 it can't help but fail by comparison. Bob spits out Cocaine.

author: maximinus
summary: Are the setlists the best thing about 1985? Bird Song with birds. Nice show overall, but needed just that little something.

author: maximinus
summary: 12 songs in the first set! Rare Let It Grow into drums. Throwing Stones > NFA is now well established. Average for the time.

author: maximinus
summary: Nobody has a birthday! Really good space with weird sounds morphs into Other One with flanged voices. Great end to the show.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent Stranger to end the first set. High energy pre-drums. Short on adventure but put together well as a whole.

author: maximinus
summary: Another early Deal. Decent ending trio for the first set. One of those shows that was nice but not at all naughty.

author: maximinus
summary: Muddy SBD. Strange pre-drums setlist. 2nd set starts with Tennessee Jed? Unfortunatly, a bit phoned in. Longest song in 1st set.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent slips another song in pre-drums. Why oh why? Rest of the show has no particular highlights, although encore is nice.

author: maximinus
summary: High Time in 1st set. Rare Sailor > Saint. Terrapin has jam of the year but Brent rams in "Don't Need Love" after 18 minutes.

author: maximinus
summary: Setlist of the year? Great Playing in the 2nd set. Second set is pretty good except last few songs. Is this encore unique?

author: maximinus
summary: Really short show - 2h 11m total. Excellent SBD. First set is pretty nice, second set is also not bad, just lacks invention.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual opener but par for the course 1st set. Second set has that 'night before new year' trope of taking it easy.

author: maximinus
summary: Audience kick things off in the first set, but that is all of note in this most restrained new years show. Disappointing.

author: maximinus
summary: First Chinese new year show? Only 2hr 5m long. Slow first set. Playin' tries something of interest but otherwise so-so.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows keep getting shorter! Tired first set. Other One in set 2 is semi-decent for a change.Still no stand-outs though.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set largly with the Nevilles. Iko with key change? Nevilles add energy, but also too many drummers. Saved by the encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Post drums also with the Nevilles. Spacey Estimated jam. Crikey, a real bass player on stage. Hand Jive is great.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry tries Lost Sailor > Terrapin but the band doesn't follow. Had no real meat to hang anything onto. Lovelight was ok.

author: maximinus
summary: First Visions of Johanna. Unfortunatly, even the board is shitty. Long and decent Playing. Weird middle to Truckin'.

author: maximinus
summary: Box Of Rain! Kudos to Brent who has a keys/drums jam instead of a song. Nothing much else to get fired up about.

author: maximinus
summary: A WTF? Let It Grow intro. Super-speedy Terrapin. Playin reprise into drums? Contains surprises, just not alays good ones.

author: maximinus
summary: Hand Jive much worse without the Nevilles. Wolf howling in Other One. Will the Other One ever go large again? Clean but mild.

author: maximinus
summary: Last Sailor Saint (!). Only one song out of space? Short show again. Phew, what a DEW! Likely best ending since 74.

author: maximinus
summary: Jeez the second set is full of short songs. First Desolation Row, it's already too long. Not really bad, more boring.

author: maximinus
summary: Supplication jam in first set. Only Hamstring Blues. Bob horrifically out of tune on Eyes. A bit better post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Short but fairly sweet jam before drums. Get it for the flow, even though songs now are generally always 10 mins max.

author: maximinus
summary: Meant to be full of energy but I didn't find that. Gimme Some Lovin tease after drums was only thing of note.

author: maximinus
summary: Cut short because a thrown bottle went through Billys kick drum. Decent Comes A Time. Some silly songs spoil this.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice fat set on paper, but played a bit too fast and with little conviction. Shows recently are more and more samey.

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby just as loud as Jerry for a change! First set has longish songs but no jams. Boring Playing jam, Brent before drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Worst Jack Straw to start? Jerry seems to have no energy. Rough first set. Foolish Heart riff pre-drums? Is this the future?

author: maximinus
summary: Sounds like Brent has some new MIDI sounds. Sounds like Jerry is almost not there. He has no spark at all in these shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Desolation Row is too long. Jerry bales halfway through Terrapin, letting Brent in with Don't Need Love. Encore was ok.

author: maximinus
summary: Super rare That's Alright Mama (which is truly dreadful) in 10 song first set. Nothing at all stood out in the 2nd set.

author: maximinus
summary: 2 songs pre-drums; 1 is a 15 min Playing. Long, but doesn't seem to go anywhere. Very mellow space. Clearly best of '86.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent has a skinful or three in the set break. Crazy breakdown, with Jerry rescuing things. Truly a unique dead show!

author: maximinus
summary: Good start to the first set and decent Bird Song. WTF is Brent playing in China Cat? Mellow half-jam out of Terrapin.

author: maximinus
summary: Short but sweet. Shows this year are way more up and down, and Jerry is often mixed low. Jerry's amp dies on the last note!

author: maximinus
summary: Seems to start with last nights encore. Really good Playin' jam - 15 minutes long. Faltered a bit towards the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Didn't have the lows of some recent shows but missed the minor highs as well. Let It Grow was probably the best moment.

author: maximinus
summary: Phil and Jerry speak at the start! Best 80's Dancin' in first set? Low energy in the second set. Strange double encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob introduces the band at the end in a cheesy way, the best thing about this show. Space was boring and Quinn is getting old.

author: maximinus
summary: Clifford Stoll was here. Almost ambient drums > space. Saint with no Sailor. Like a lot of 86, Jerry seems lethargic.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set opens with Fire On The Mountain! Quite a lot of songs and not short but it seems the band are done by the 2nd set.

author: maximinus
summary: One long set, which is nearly 2 hours long. Worst aud for a long, long time. Really, nothing at all stood out here.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set looks good on paper, and pre-drums is definitly quite nice. Unfortunatly rest of the show is more normal '86.

author: maximinus
summary: Less than 2 hours total for this show! Something is not right when Jerry goes for the big solos. Eyes is both fast AND short.

author: maximinus
summary: All the energy is at the start of these shows. This wasn't terrible, except maybe for song choice. No surprises.

author: maximinus
summary: Dylan joins for part of set 1 (not great). Jerry misses 10 minutes of set 2 (not bad). Overall though, nothing exciting.

author: maximinus
summary: Farm Aid show. Pretty much all short songs. Stand-alone Fire was pretty good. Fast paced and ragged throughout.

author: maximinus
summary: Too fast and too messy, although Let It Grow had a try at decency. Sloppy, bad audience tape and lacking in energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Again with Dylan for 2 songs, who plays the worst guitar ever at a Dead show. Jerry doesn't sound too bad on Wharf Rat.

author: maximinus
summary: Comeback show. It was a bit tighter than recently and had 2 new songs, but I wouldn't call it a classic show. So-so.

author: maximinus
summary: Slightly better than last night, still had that more professional feel, but nothing really stood out except Sugaree.

author: maximinus
summary: A decent length 2nd set at long last. This definitly has a better flow about it. Best show of the 3, decent throughout.

author: maximinus
summary: Sounding much better than the summer. A better band, even if the jams are not there. Playing sandwich for the whole show!

author: maximinus
summary: Slightly shorter, as if the band are getting ready for the new year shows again. Nothing outstanding, but overall decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Has 3 drums listed + Olin Arrageed! Ballads have got better on the comeback. Band cohesion is noticably better this tour.

author: maximinus
summary: Short 3rd set mixes things up a little. Jerry's voice a lot better than the summer. Still waiting for the jams though.

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby struggles to sing Get Back. Second set is a real clunker, possibly worst Eyes ever. Jerry forgets words everywhere.

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby struggles all evening since Otis just died. Jerry is better than last night, but that's not saying much.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob horrifically out of tune at points. 87 is slowly getting better but this was worst start to a year I remember.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Let It Grow in first set. Songs are starting to get longer again, and there are more, but it still lacks overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Shaky start to Jack Straw. SBD's recently are fantastic. Decent Stranger and Estimated, rest a bit muted. Not too bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Iko with horns, initially very messy. Nothing really else stood out in this show, to be honest - it was quite pedestrian.

author: maximinus
summary: First east coast show since the coma. Awful SBD. Unusual Sugar Mag sandwich for second set, but no real highlights.

author: maximinus
summary: Another board that sounds like an aud. Big River has an excellent Mydland solo. Good energy. Strong Eyes hint in space.

author: maximinus
summary: Energy from the off. Not a fan of these Healy ultra-mixes. High energy Terrapin. Great intro to Fantasy. A good show!

author: maximinus
summary: Either the mix or the sound system has changed since Summer 86 - for the better. Great first set, and decent energy all over.

author: maximinus
summary: What gives with these SBDs? Post drums short but sweet, UJB > Dew. Not a bad show, except for a screwup in Dew by Jerry.

author: maximinus
summary: This spring tour has loads of energy - it's off the charts here. Playing' was the best, setlist was like 86 but higher energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Really excellent first set. He's Gone dragged a bit, but one of the best Throwing Stones and a decent post-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry really tries to twist the jam out of Estimated. Best Aroundx2 since the 70s? Like a steamroller to the head.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows are great in the energy department but they could do with a touch more jamming. Eyes is too short here.

author: maximinus
summary: Samson into drums is weird. Short Drums / Space. Other One starts with a semi-Spanish jam. Not as good as recent shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Energy a bit lower in this show. Still suffering from the "songs too short in second set" syndrome. Not a good Dew.

author: maximinus
summary: Holy shit what a Jack Straw solo! Terrapin out of space? Not a bad one though. Even other One got a little funky.

author: maximinus
summary: Great HIAB technical screw-up. Little Slipknot riff in space. Little bit less exciting than recent shows, but not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set has a great playlist but's more of a tease, especially the 30 second Playing reprise. Overall, not so bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Energy from start of tour seems weakened by now, or perhaps it was just last night. First set better than the second.

author: maximinus
summary: Almost like 2 first sets; the curse of 1985 still extends it's hand. Space and the encore were the best parts of the show.

author: maximinus
summary: 87 so far has islands of high energy shows but this is not one. Truckin falls flat, Jerry's voice falters and no jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Longish tuning melody in first set. Let It Grow not bad. Promoter warning after first set. Unfinished Dew!?! Not good.

author: maximinus
summary: Strange second set list (Muddy > Miracle > Cumberland > Drums ?). Nearly an Other One sandwich post drums. Recently lackluster.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual Sat Night to end set 1. Good outro from space which was almost correct. Yet another Dew - and a decent one.

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby high in the mix. It's a killer sound and I enjoyed almost all of it. Fun tuning in the first set as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Rare Sugar Mag sandwich for show. Great Mexicali - Bob very clear. Brent: "I hope my bass player can give me some slack".

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby "way too fucking slow" in Man Smart. Decent Stranger in first setlist. Playin' post drums. Had potential.

author: maximinus
summary: One of the better late China Riders. Brent has new violin sound. Overall nothing outstanding but it was a decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent setlist. Pity The Other One is now a 5 minute post drums filler. Show was good but could have brought more fire.

author: maximinus
summary: Good, if predictable, post drums. Monkees in space. Throwing Stones always has the usual format now. Solid, unspectacular.

author: maximinus
summary: LSD warning at start of show. Great first set. Decent space as well. Not a great setlist but all the energy was there.

author: maximinus
summary: Weird second set start and pre-drums list. Deal > Drums? More song based than jam based. First Watchtower was ok enough.

author: maximinus
summary: Rare (now) Alabama opener. Brent's voice is gone. Unusual setlist, but done well. Masterpiece WTF. Best NFA for a long time.

author: maximinus
summary: No SBD for a change. Whale song pre-drums out of Eyes. High energy almost all of post-drums. Needed more exploration though.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Let It Grow. Setlist for set 2 is fantastic. Good drums. Good show overall, but lacked a special moment somewhere.

author: maximinus
summary: Very weird non-sung ending to what could have been a good Dew. Everything seems good again, just lacks the adventure.

author: maximinus
summary: Crowd very lively for Good Lovin' sing along. Energy is great again. The curse of 87 seems unwillingness to explore.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows have far more energy than recent years but lack inventivness. Enjoying the Muddy River encores though.

author: maximinus
summary: First Dylan + Dead show. Jerry on pedal steel! It's more Dylan than Dead though. Kinda glad there's only 6 at this point.

author: maximinus
summary: Pre-drums with the Nevilles (who always do the same songs). Sounded like more fun on stage - a strange Dead show.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Morning Dew was a welcome return to "normal Dead". 2 shows away and I'd already missed them! Still no real jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Roanoke. Remember this one being well liked when it came out. Fullt of energy, happy sounding, no big jams - all 87.

author: maximinus
summary: 1st and 2nd sets condensed. 3rd set with Dylan again. Better set than the last one, despite the Queen Jane car crash.

author: maximinus
summary: Dew to open short 2nd set. Third show with Dylan. Suffers from the band holding back because of the third set.

author: maximinus
summary: Again the GD seem to lack a bit of sparkle because of having to do 3 sets. Dylan sets starting to sound the same.

author: maximinus
summary: 5th Dylan show! Longest Funinculi? Rare Scarlet > Playing. Dead ripping with energy. Possibly best Dylan set so far.

author: maximinus
summary: A semi-decent Other One. Longest Dylan set so far. This had different songs from the others, but previous night was better.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Crazy > Samson. Pre-drums is really well done. Slightly unusual setlist, and all the better for it; a decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice end to set 2. Not as good as the previous night though. Energy good but more subdued than the spring. Standard 87.

author: maximinus
summary: All 3 of this run have been solid. He's Gone for a dead fan was heartfelt. Lacked in energy but made up in majesty.

author: maximinus
summary: Solid show and a good run post-drums. Another good Dew, seems common in this period. Another good set-list as well.

author: maximinus
summary: There's just a sense of fun in these shows that recent years have lacked. Good space here, and best ever encore screw up.

author: maximinus
summary: Promising setlist but the PITB was a bit lazy and nothing really gelled that strongly. Didn't do it for me.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent tunings, a long first set and a hit list of songs post drums are the ingredients, but this didn't no anything for me.

author: maximinus
summary: End of first set with Santana - laid back but not bad. Great HIAB, but after that died a bit. Still, Santana made it unique.

author: maximinus
summary: Again with Santana in the 1st set. Good looking setlist. Double encore. On paper looks great, but it could have been more.

author: maximinus
summary: First La Bamba since forever. Typical 87 show: energy is decent, playing is there but simply no real jams at all.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual Fire on it's own. Show is mainly ok, suffers from a dip in energy after drums. Promised more that it delivered.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent opens with Hey Pocky Way. Devil with a blue dress? Nice mellow Playin'. Second set is really short, only an hour!

author: maximinus
summary: Shows seem to be getting a little shorter again. Mickey's birthday has a great setlist but falls over on the jams again.

author: maximinus
summary: Great first set. Second set was no slouch either. Another good Morning Dew, and a double encore to follow.

author: maximinus
summary: Super-rare cover of Fever. Good setlist for second set, but lacked energy until the end. Another version of La Bamba.

author: maximinus
summary: First set has equipment problems. Great Eyes in 2nd set - best for a long time. These shows are pretty decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Scarlet 2nd song in first set? Jerry goes wild in Wharf Rat. Excepting the "Blue Dress", another good 87 show.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Watchtower, Masterpiece and another GL > La Bamba > GL. More aggressive than usual Bird Song. Great Dew, solid.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent pre-drums, but drums is better! Best drums that I ever recall. Really really badly cut into Maggies Farm.

author: maximinus
summary: Starts with 2 tuning riffs! High energy pre-drums but it lacks a bit post drums. Not at the heights of recent shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Spencer Davis guests for Good Lovin', adds little except for vocals. Pleasant enough but generally a weak show.

author: maximinus
summary: Had a good setlist but the shows seem to have calmed down a bit since the start of the month. High energy end to the show.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's voice is not so good. For a change Other One goes over 6 mins. Slight strange setlist but no major highlights.

author: maximinus
summary: Is LiG the best song for jamming in the first set? Maybe. Great Watchtower. Weird last song. Decent drums/space.

author: maximinus
summary: Really good Bird Song but the second set was more anonymous than recent shows. Lots of Adams Family tune-ups recently.

author: maximinus
summary: Pretty short, and largely anonymous. A mere 6 minutes for pre drums Eyes? Also, Good Golly Miss Molly is terrible.

author: maximinus
summary: Standards have slipped since earlier this year. This show is not bad, just lacks the unusual. Interesting Scarlet > Hell.

author: maximinus
summary: Overall a slighty better show than a few recent ones. Setlist was really good, could have had a bit more fire.

author: maximinus
summary: Another 9 minutes Other One, but this show mainly relies on too many short songs in the second set. A common 1987 trait.

author: maximinus
summary: Opens with a 13 minute Shakedown. Show is pretty short again compared to spring summer. Great Lovelight false ending.

author: maximinus
summary: November shows are patchy compared with earlier this year. So-so setlist and no real highlights, even with a Dew.

author: maximinus
summary: Awesome pre drums selection. Drops off a bit post drums but it's still worth a listen. Decent Quinn encore as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Has to the worst pre-drums selection for a time. First set and post drums saves it somewhat but not the best show.

author: maximinus
summary: Not a bad show for a pre new years. The Dew could have been better and the jams were short. Best was the first set LiG.

author: maximinus
summary: 3rd set with the Nevilles. Rest sounds like a fairly normal show for the period, albeit with no major highlights.

author: maximinus
summary: First set ends with Loser? Seemed to be a bit of a warm-up for the start of the year. Short, strange post Good Lovin jam.

author: maximinus
summary: Fairly normal show. Space was quite nice. Recently setlists have become more predictable; also there is still a lack of jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Competent but as usual for the era lacking in any form of jamming. Also really short, second set is only ~75 minutes.

author: maximinus
summary: Bog standard show showing the more mundane parts of 1987. Songs decent enough, but missing big energy and jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Really solid first set. Decent Playing for the period. Pre-drums has jamming! Big improvement from the February shows.

author: maximinus
summary: First Fantasy > Hey Jude. Not as good as the previous night, but overall not bad and the Hey Jude was definitly a plus.

author: maximinus
summary: Fairly normal show for the period. The NFA at the end was probably the best for a while though, Jerry went off a little bit.

author: maximinus
summary: End of first set is nice, and a decent Half-Step to start the second. Rest of second set couldn't match it though.

author: maximinus
summary: Weird Stir It up in first set. Decent, very active, space. Pre-drums was mellow but not bad. Post drums more predictable.

author: maximinus
summary: Most bizarre start to a second set for a long long time. Eyes needs to move away from pre-drums. Nice surprises in this show.

author: maximinus
summary: Messy Stranger end. End of first set is much better (BS > Music). Second set is less surprising. NFA with no chant!

author: maximinus
summary: Second set setlist looks awesome on paper. Shakedown has lost an edge over the years. Decent Dew but skimped on jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Consistent LiG quality recently. Strange exit from space. Post drums, longest song was 4:24! Major car crash in Watchtower.

author: maximinus
summary: Tunings are off the hook. Great To Lay Me Down. Nicely jammed Estimated. Best Other One for a while. Patchy in places.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's voice is bad due to a cold. Vocal jams out of LLR are getting boring. Good Stella Blue and high energy end.

author: maximinus
summary: Louie Louie from Brent. Best Smokestack Lightning ever, bar none. Decent from that point on, with a lot of energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Best Around x 2 - at end of first set - for years was still only average. Setlist looks good on paper kind of show.

author: maximinus
summary: Another decent setlist but Jerry has sounded out of sorts for the last few shows. Passable, space was pretty OK.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual Big Boss Man opener. Hey Jude seems in place now. Another LLR pre-drums second set. Fairly ho-hum, like last night.

author: maximinus
summary: To Lay Me Down song of the tour. Decent first set. Jerry's voice better, and overall improvement from the previous week.

author: maximinus
summary: Interesting Sugar Mag / Playing duel sandwich show. Show definitly peaks in the white-hot Morning Dew. Reccomended.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice Bird Song at the end of the first set but nothing else about this show stood out. A bit by the numbers for my taste.

author: maximinus
summary: Scarlet > Fire to open the first set? Apart from that opener, there was nothing special. Post-drums was all short songs.

author: maximinus
summary: Like a lot of this run it is acceptable with no errors, but it needs something more - mainly in the jamming department.

author: maximinus
summary: There's some good setlists on this tour and it seems free of errors but the jam level seriously needs to up a notch.

author: maximinus
summary: Quality Bird Song at end of 1st set. Yet another LLR > Terrapin pre drums. Must say post-drums recently has got samey.

author: maximinus
summary: First LTGTR. Better pre-drums than recently. China > Rider and 3 song encore was a nice surprise. Again, almost no jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice relaxed first set. Post-drums is yet another O1 > Wharf > TS > NFA. Needs some more variety in this spot.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusually, no SBD for this show. Decent space and pretty high energy post drums. Pity about the sound quality though.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows are getting really short on the jamming front. This rips through the songs with the exception of Bird Song.

author: maximinus
summary: First Blow Away? Shows are reminding me a bit of 1986, but with less setlist variation. Tiny tiny DS hint at end of Other One.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusually, no SBD. Sounds like Jerry doesn't know the new Brent song. Stella Blue major car crash; crushes the solo though.

author: maximinus
summary: Alpine SBD's this year have a slight chorus effect. Mellow first set. He's Gone > DS not a bad combo. Encore is funny.

author: maximinus
summary: First show with Hornsby. New songs and chatting are probably the highlight again. Tapes for this show are a little rough.

author: maximinus
summary: Again, no soundboard. Seems a bit low on energy, although Playing actually tries a jam. Post drums seems to be best nowadays.

author: maximinus
summary: Bit more open than recent shows. Estimated lacked bite. Almost a jam pre-drums. Good Stella Blue. Does summer 88 have any jams?

author: maximinus
summary: Believe It Or Not is not a great song. Kills a the mood a bit pre drums. Overall, nothing really bad but nothing exciting.

author: maximinus
summary: Super solid set-list for set 2. Short on jamming but pre-drums was fun. Too many gated drums this year. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Short first set but ends with a killer Bird Song. IWTYH pre-drums, oh dear. Very weird second set ending, and NFA encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Another good Morning Dew to end the set but nothing much else stood out. Lovelight as stand-alone encore was unusual.

author: maximinus
summary: "I Will Take You Home" - post space! Very short, perfunctory Other One. Didn't really hang well together as a show.

author: maximinus
summary: Laid back first set. Pre-drums is the best part, although suffering from no jamming. Blackbird encore might be the highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set ends with hot Deal. Unusual China > CF > Rider. Contender for best Playin' of the 80's. Post drums lacks though.

author: maximinus
summary: No decent SBD. Decent start to first set. Nothing hot, although the Smokestack out of space was rare for the period and decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent Bird Song ends ineresting first set. IWTYH - awful. Very unusual, good, mellow drums section. Post drums is excellent.

author: maximinus
summary: Didn't bring a lot to the table. A lot of these shows are very similar to each other, differentation seems to be in the energy.

author: maximinus
summary: First time in years there was a tiny hint of jam after Truckin'. Other than that, this show seems a bit tired and lackluster.

author: maximinus
summary: Let It Grow is again the start of set 1. Nice contrasts in drums / space. Some early MIDI? Lacks any real energy.

author: maximinus
summary: MIDI and a meltdown in the Bird Song! Electric Ripple as the second encore, unfortunatly the bits inbetween lacked.

author: maximinus
summary: Only aud for second set. No highlights, although setlist suggests one. Another Playin' reprise, no longer rare. So-So.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice choice of songs for the first set, but there was nothing really inventive in this show. Post drumrs is very regular.

author: maximinus
summary: Let It Grow threatens a breakdown. Rest was however a lot more standard, with nothing in particular standing out.

author: maximinus
summary: Both sets quite short (second set especially so). IWTYH out of space again. Very average, except for the Believe It Or Not.

author: maximinus
summary: Slightly unusual pre drums combination of Scarlet > Fire, apart from that nothing special. Lacking unpredictability, these shows.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows are really just washing over me a bit too much. They are not bad as much as lacking in variety. Hoping for better.

author: maximinus
summary: Lot's of minor errors in this show. Sounds like the band are unsure of themselves. Saved by the Dew and the encore at the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Almost typical 1988 setlist, sublime to ridiculous (Playing paired with UJB seems common). Normal show, but pre drums was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Not a bad show at all; energy from the start and throughout. Estimated > Terrapin > DS were the highlights, sans Bobby screams.

author: maximinus
summary: Good first set, and mainly decent up to drums. NFA chant to start second set. Post drums was OO > WR > TS > NFA again.

author: maximinus
summary: Another Playing reprise pre-drums - seems to be getting quite common. Could have with a pinch more energy but not too bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Another Morning Dew to end the show but not as epic as recent versions. Rare (now) JB Goode to end, but this show needed more.

author: maximinus
summary: Only 1980's song was Fantasy. Opens with a long Shakedown. Excellent TLMD. Post drums had some unsually placed mellow moments.

author: maximinus
summary: This MSG run goes on forever. Foolish into drums + keys jam. How many IWTYH must be endured? Fairly decent Other One though.

author: maximinus
summary: Suzanne Vega, Mick Taylor... Hall & Oates? Suzanne is probably the best. Jerry's voice is shot and this is cringeworthy at times.

author: maximinus
summary: Nothing really stands out in this short show. Setlist not too bad and Jerry's voice is better, but this is to "by the numbers".

author: maximinus
summary: Late 88 is worse than either the previous year of indeed the spring. Here post drums is the best of an overally average show.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual spaces cropping up pre-drums make this a nice change but otherwise a fairly standard show. Messy Stones and a cut NFA.

author: maximinus
summary: Rare (by now) Saint Of Circumstance. Good setlist other than this, but again no real jamming. Another Hey Jude slow down finish.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual openers - Music Never Stopped start for 1st set, Sat Night for 2nd. Otherwise, this seemed a pretty low energy show.

author: maximinus
summary: Bit of a clunker of a show. Ended with the least climatic Dew I've ever heard. Jerry himself didn't rate the band this tour.

author: maximinus
summary: Better than the last 2 shows. Encore with the Bangles (?). Was Bobby banging a bangle? Space was decent until IWTYH arrived.

author: maximinus
summary: Roughest tape I've heard for some time. First Built To Last. Nice Hey Jude outro with the crowd but the source was terrible.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice Jack Straw to end set one. Overall quite a "happy" show with Happy Birthday for Brent and a great Stella Blue.

author: maximinus
summary: Starts off OK then fades off on the energy level. Nice to have Jack-A-Row back but could have done with more energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Very average show with no real spark or energy, except maybe a little pick-up post drums. I think Jerry needs more energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Either the mix or something else is up in these shows - Jerry lacks bite. A bit more interesting post drums with the setlist.

author: maximinus
summary: Good out the gate. Is that just the high quality though? Great Bird Song. Great space and setlist. Where did this come from?

author: maximinus
summary: Brent playing well. Samson > Playing jam? Mostly par for the course but not a bad show for the regular show before new year.

author: maximinus
summary: First show with Clarence? Adds a lot but is a bit too busy. Very long drums. Dew winds to a standstill. Weird triple encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Drums > He's Gone > Miracle > Dew!? First SOTM and We Can Run (latter a bit messy). Nice Playin'. Nice show overall, nearly a 4.

author: maximinus
summary: Strange NFA > Sugaree start. Set 1 ends with Tennessee Jed! Quite a long Terrapin jam. Killer Stella Blue. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent songs not too bad here. Victim has a car crash at the start. Space arrives with a bang. Nice setlists recently.

author: maximinus
summary: Tunings are ever more playful. Great LIG to finish first set. Fine Playin' jam. Another pretty decent show overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Seems like Jerry has a little less energy this evening. First set has a great Bird Song though. Long Estimated as well.

author: maximinus
summary: With Spencer Davis and Dylan for the 2nd set. Best Gimme Some Loving. Bizarre setlist, overall a pretty strange show.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer Half-Step opener. Fire is full of energy near the end. Maybe needs some more energy near the peaks. 1989 sounds good.

author: maximinus
summary: Started off hot. Second set could have more ups and downs - it was a bit too smooth - but hard to argue with. Decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent Bird Song and great first set. He's Gone nearly 16 mins long. Even a decent Other One post drums. 89 has started well.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent offered weed to play. Terrapin at over 16.5 minutes! Really good Morning Dew to finish the set. Even IWTYH was acceptable.

author: maximinus
summary: First set is nice, but the Shakedown that opens set 2 is better! High energy needs some better direction towards the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Very nice mixed up first set setlist. Blow Away was decent at start of second set. Not brilliant but still a decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: The "Blues" show! Unusual US Blues to end the first set. Nice comeback for China Doll. Well played in the main, lacking jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry is a little low in the mix. Really decent Playin' jam in set 2. Stunning intro into Built To Last. Pretty good again.

author: maximinus
summary: Little Slipknot riff in space. Nothing really stands out in this show but the quality is all there. Good Blow Away as well.

author: maximinus
summary: This is the best tour of the 1980's so far. Even "average" shows like this have great little jams (here Estimated > UJB).

author: maximinus
summary: Lacked a bit of the class of recent shows, although not terrible as such. Crazy Fingers > Playin > Terrapin was not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: LiG at end of first set and a nice bluesy jam out of Truckin' were the highlight. Rest was a lot more average. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: This set, whilst not particularly bad in any obvious way, also didn't feature anything exciting. New songs need more jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Really slow Blow Away. Playing went fairly dissonant. Dew is nice as well, but the rest of show lacks a bit of spark.

author: maximinus
summary: Rare (now) Saint of Circumstance (not played well). Scarlet Fire was decent but otherwise this show fails to inspire.

author: maximinus
summary: First show with MIDI guitars (in space). This section was quite fun, unlike the rest of the gig which was too average for me.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual Crazy Fingers to start set 2 (which has a great setlist). Short but killer Playin'. Sugar Mag > Touch to end?

author: maximinus
summary: Really wish IWTYH didn't come out of space. Lots of MIDI in space. Best Other One for a while. Even the Lovelight was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Quite a mellow show with some longish jams (Estimated > Eyes 25 minutes!) but could have been a bit more out there overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Car crash Miracle. Show was pretty nice and had surprises (the end of Around was a WTF though), although needed more jams.

author: maximinus
summary: First set a bit stiff. Quite a long section pre-drums but was a bit too much up and down for my liking. A bit phoned in.

author: maximinus
summary: Benefit for Aids (Jerry + Bob + fogerty opened). First time in years, a minor Truckin jam. Great drums / space. Happy show.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Hey Pocky Way > Iko transition. Car crash "Saint". Is Brent drunk? Cipollina He's Gone with decent jam. Very up and down.

author: maximinus
summary: Kick-ass Rider riffs from Jerry. Smooth Playin' jam into Crazy Fingers. Overall very decent, almost a 4 but not quite.

author: maximinus
summary: Major Bobby amp issues at start. Particularly long space. With Clarence Clemons, who adds little. Could have been hotter.

author: maximinus
summary: Playin' > Crazy Fingers to open. Faster than usual FOTD. Decent He's Gone > Eyes. Epic ending of Fantasy > Jude > Sugar Mag.

author: maximinus
summary: Good first set with everything decent. Great pre drums with meaty Terrapin. Great space, killer Watchtower. Great show.

author: fan-archive note
summary: JFK '89 — large-scale stadium era

author: maximinus
summary: Hot from the start. Killer MIDI in the Other One. No particular highlight as such, just a well played show overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Opens with high energy. Awesome Bird Song to end first set. Best Truckin' jam of the 80's so far. Energy level off the charts!

author: maximinus
summary: Needs a longer jam in there somewhere (although UJB was 12 mins+) but hard to argue against the overall quality of this.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set starts with Sugaree. Good Black Peter was the highlight, but overall this show couldn't keep up with recent ones.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry flute and lots of MIDI in space. 2nd set He's Gone opener. All the songs were solid but none of them really stood out.

author: maximinus
summary: Very long Bird song but not as good as the last one. Truly excellent Truckin' > Smokestack. Close Encounters in space.

author: maximinus
summary: The main treat in this show is the pre-drums China > Rider / Playin > UJB. Even the NFA was pretty meaty. Band on fire this era!

author: maximinus
summary: High energy first set. Crazy smooth Sugar Mag > Scarlet transition. Tour is screaming for a major jam. Fiery post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Rocking Deal and great first set. This run is a bit of tease with no major jams. Pretty glorious run overall though.

author: maximinus
summary: Another killer Deal in an 11 song first set. Solo Jerry in space. A bit rushed through the songs and not as good as recent shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Had some good points at the end of set 1 and pre-drums (Playing > Rider !?) but lost some energy on the back straight.

author: maximinus
summary: There was a cool jam in Bird Song but most of the second set felt a little flat. Decent encore (JB Goode > WBYGN) though.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent MIDIfied Space is the highlight of this show. Some length in the songs (13 min Estimated) but they lack depth.

author: maximinus
summary: Tough to characterise. All the songs are played reasonably well but there are no real highlights. 2 Jerry ballads post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Seems like drums is getting shorter and space longer. Nice mellow pre-drums Playing jam. Excellent Other One post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Mellow and decent first set ends in excellent Bird Song. Lots of MIDI in Terrapin. Minimilistic space. Death Don't. Cracking.

author: maximinus
summary: Went pretty well up the drums (Estimated > Trucking was decent enough) but the energy died after, despite a bunch of rockers.

author: maximinus
summary: Scarlet > Man Smart? The latter was quite decent. Long space. Lacks a decent jam and not that energetic. Lovelight gets weird.

author: maximinus
summary: Good show, patchy in some minor areas. But the HOTW, pre-drums and especially the Morning Dew added enough to make a good show.

author: maximinus
summary: This Dark Star is almost certainly the best, and possibly, the longest jam of the 80's to date. Fantastic DDHNM post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Overall very hit and miss. China Cat is decent but there are too many mistakes. Worst Wheel ever? Band are out of steam.

author: maximinus
summary: All Bird Songs are easily over the 12 min mark now. Nothing obvious stood out, except maybe less errors than the previous night.

author: maximinus
summary: Short show (only 2 songs post drums). Great H>S>F to end 1st set. Contains the longest (but not the best) Truckin' jam since 74.

author: maximinus
summary: Many 2nd set songs have gained a minute or more. This was a bit like a return to the August shows. Needed more jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: Hell of a 2nd set setlist. Long jam is interesting at start and end of pre-drums. Brent and Bob try to ruin post drums. Solid.

author: maximinus
summary: A bit minimal, but an actual Terrapin jam. Post drums was a bit ho-hum, although I wouldn't say it was a bad show.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set and nice second set setlist. Nice jam out of Estimated. Overall not a bad show, although it lacked a big moment.

author: maximinus
summary: Long show with first California Earthquake. An actual Truckin' / OO jam with meltdown? What a hidden gem, despite IWTYH post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Great first set contains killer Bird Song and ends with JB Goode! Space jam after Franklins pre drums. Close encounters in space.

author: maximinus
summary: Starts great - the Stranger is excellent. Pre drums a little so-so but post drums is great. Best Lovelight since 72? Killer encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Another Playin > UJB to start set 2. Best UJB jam since 74 at least. Truckin' has a jam again! Rocked out ending as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Best Victim so far. 26 minutes of Dark Star, although not as good as 10/9. Whole show is pretty decent, although I've heard weirder.

author: maximinus
summary: Another excellent Victim. Wierd clipped Sugra Mag out of Scarlet. Pretty good but lacking some of the spark of recent shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Not as good as recent shows but the base quality was still there and Help > Slip > Franklins carried the day to a large degree.

author: maximinus
summary: First set contains decent Bird Song with MIDI. Pretty robust Playing. Nice, but lacked anything particularly special post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Car crash rescue in HIAB! Monster Victim. CC Rider with Spencer Davis. China-Rider and space both good. Best Stella Blue for a while.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice first set but starts to go really deep in the Playin' jam. Garcias guitar cuts out in Dew, but still a killer version.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Stranger with a major Jerry error - "Whoops!". "Sleepy summer home" in Eyes? More traditional drums. Bit laid back but not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: High energy first set - best of the year? Dark Star goes crazy 10 minutes in. Runs slighty out of steam post drums. Good fun.

author: maximinus
summary: Good "Last Time" - first for 25 years? No big jams, but very high quality post drums. Best Wharf Rat for a long time. Rocking.

author: maximinus
summary: Good banter in the first set. Really long 30min Scarlet > Fire and long versions of all songs pre-drums. Laid back and decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Victim drops a space section in the first set. First set, opening set 2 weirdness and the Dew are good but maybe a bit more needed.

author: maximinus
summary: Great first set with first Loose Lucy since 74. Pre-drums has an interesting Playin' jam. Decent start to Spring 90 tour.

author: maximinus
summary: Phils 50th bday. Very mellow, long jam out of Terrapin. Wharf Rat reminded me of the 70s. Great encore, best Revolution I heard.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer Bird Song after BT Wind. Almost an Eyes jam out of Man Smart. Pre-drum jams seem to be the new norm. Could have had more.

author: maximinus
summary: First set opens with a nice Shakedown but lacks surprises. Nice Truckin > Spoonful jam pre-drums. Great Morning Dew to finish.

author: maximinus
summary: Picasso Moon can't seem to end! Very good Playin' is too short. Dropped off post drums to be honest, and needed a bit more energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Victim > SOTM > Promised in first set? Probably the best part, along with the second set Crazy Fingers. Tour needs more jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Scarlet > Fire. Jam after Truckin is a highlight, although short; same could be said for the Other One. Full Hey Jude.

author: maximinus
summary: Great 2nd set pre-drums comes complete with a full Mind Left Body jam which along, with the rest of pre-drums, is the highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Probably the longest Eyes since 77 or so to start set 2. Spoonful jam takes a short left turn. Ran out of steam post-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Don't like the new lyrics in BT Wind. Nothing of major note in this show, although nothing bad. Dew saves the day at end of set 2.

author: maximinus
summary: First "The Weight". But that into Hey Pocky Way > Drums sums up this slight ho-hum show. Decent drums and Wharf Rat save the show.

author: maximinus
summary: The Branford show. Eyes is great. Amazingly, once in Star, he holds them back if anything. A very, very good one trick pony.

author: maximinus
summary: Best first set for a while. Pre drums jam is pretty decent - a good Playin' - although post drums is a little more rote. Enjoyable.

author: maximinus
summary: Even better first set than last night, killer ending. This time post drums is better than pre, with a great Stella Blue.

author: maximinus
summary: Average for the tour, even with a DDHNM (the weakest of the modern ones so far). Strange to have Last Time into drums, for sure.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent Row Jimmy (!). Brent is killing on the keys. Very jammy run into drums, culminates in an awesome Playin'. Killer.

author: maximinus
summary: Great opening sequence and a very good first set. Quality continues into set 2, although post drums is less so. Decent show overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Another great first set. Second set a bit up and down, with the Weight still in a pre-drums roll. Set 1 earns the makes here.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Foolish Heart jam goes into killer Drums > Sapce. Post drums slacks a bit energy wise but overall this is a good show.

author: maximinus
summary: Overall a very decent show but lacking a solid highlight. The opener of both sets was probably the best; another good Victim.

author: maximinus
summary: Really good into drums with a cracking Eyes and good Playing jam. Best SOTM so far post-drums, and even the set 1 starter was good.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Help > Slipknot to open. Really long show for the era. Around & Around doesn't want to end. Come for the energy, not the jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Really, REALLY long jam out of Terrapin, which is mainly a Jerry space. This is a very weird second set, and that's a good thing.

author: maximinus
summary: Sounds like the after-party to the night before, a bit up and down in places. Playing > Eyes and Shakedown are the highlights.

author: maximinus
summary: Another robust pre-drums jam fest. Great Drums and space, also full of energy. I'm getting used to regularly having good shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Starts decent but overall a bit more anonymous than recent shows. Sugar Mag goes off-key in the middle. Below average for the tour.

author: maximinus
summary: Slighty anonymous start. Jerry and Phil in shorts. Unusual Scarlet > Fire after after 3 songs in second set. A bit so-so.

author: maximinus
summary: Long and energetic He's Gone jam, beats most early 80's efforts. Rest of show is more normal. Around & Around still disappoints.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice jam out of Terrapin and a laid back Eyes again. Not sure what Wang Dang Doodle after space was doing though. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Loser and killer Bird Song. Power cut in Promised Land! Great (and jammy) 2nd set. Space > Other One was particularly good.

author: maximinus
summary: Long Star but it lacks a freakout session. Drums / space is excellent and the end is rocking. Definitly worth a listen.

author: maximinus
summary: Really tight first set with good start and end. Killer "Step Back" to open set 2. Set 2 looks good on paper but is more pedestrian.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent High Time in average first set. Another Sugar Mag > Scarlet. Great Truckin' jam pre-drums. Around x2 is back to short again.

author: maximinus
summary: Awesome setlist. Laughing jam in drums / space. Pretty decent Other One > Dew combo at end of second set make this one stand out.

author: maximinus
summary: Really good Victim > Foolish Heart to open the second set but the rest, despite a good set-list, was a lot more pedestrian.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer, spacey Bird Song to end set 1. Solid show. 3 Playing in the bands! The end of set 2 was a decent treat and held energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Stranger. Nice Estimated > Eyes pre drums. Backwards looping in space. The whole is nice but nothing of particular note.

author: maximinus
summary: Brent's last show. Nice Truckin + jam to end first set. Another killer Victim. Terrapin jam could have been better. Was alright.

author: Vince + Bruce era
summary: Vince Welnick + Bruce Hornsby first run

author: maximinus
summary: Keys sound different right away. Long first set had extra verse in Masterpiece. Second set has long Playing jam. Average.

author: maximinus
summary: Really good first set. Very meaty Eyes > Estimated > Terrapin pre drums. Good Stella Blue after drums. Solid, decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: Slight unusual second set list spoiled this a little. Jamming blew a little hot and cold. Another decent Other One post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer HIAB to finish the first set. Stunning He's Gone > Spoonful jam - best ever? Rest of show can't match this monster.

author: maximinus
summary: UJB > Space > Drums > Dew is 52 mins. Crikey! Rest of show is no slouch either, although not to the heights of the last night.

author: maximinus
summary: Another crazy jam-fest in set 2, and the first set wasn't too bad either. Vince's high singing is a bit too high for my tastes.

author: maximinus
summary: 2 keyboards? Not sure if it works for me. This is a fairly high energy show, the setlist was decent and the jamming was alright.

author: maximinus
summary: Really long Deal to end set 1. Intense, twisted He's Gone > Drums. Almost double-dips after SOTM. Crazy, even the Dew was good!

author: maximinus
summary: Ripping opening. Best Picasso Moon to date. Jerry and Bruce led jam out of Foolish nearly hits Other One. Pretty good.

author: maximinus
summary: Excellent jam out of Let It Grow into drums. Long second sets on this mini tour. Overall a very good show. Even Aroundx2 was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: A 30-minute monster Dark Star after drums? What a difference a year makes. Jammiest post drums since '74? Absolutly epic show.

author: maximinus
summary: Really messy first set. Second set recovers a bit but is still a bit flat. Worst show of the year, but band seem to be enjoying it.

author: maximinus
summary: Lacks anything really stand out but the band is good enough to carry it. Nice High Time in first set. First dodgy Vince sound.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows are a lot more normal than the MSG shows. All of this show is nice and well done, with a rocking end, but lacks jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Bruce solo joining LiG to Box Of Rain. Unusual Eyes > Samson join. Mellow, short Star into drums. Lacks a bit in energy levels.

author: maximinus
summary: My first show. First Valley Road. First set is not that badly done. Pre-drums is decent but lacks compared to previous tour.

author: maximinus
summary: Edge has definitly come off a little since summer. They're even a bit sloppy post drums. Doesn't help the energy is not here.

author: maximinus
summary: Again this is not a bad show but all the fun of summer seems to have gone away. Space is nice enough, and gets better at the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set up until Stander On The Mountain. Second set was decent (good Victim) but lacked a jam. Heavens Door encore good.

author: maximinus
summary: Good first set - best of the tour so far. Bruce solo solos are way too self-indulgent. Wierd phone call in drums. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent and long first set opens with Help > Slip. Second set is also long but lacks major highlights excepting maybe the Watchtower.

author: maximinus
summary: Last night of Europe tour. Jerry has a terrible voice. Jam is long but lacks excitement. Weird start to Wharf Rat. Worst US Blues?

author: maximinus
summary: Estimated good until Jerry (!) cuts it short. Terrapin mild car crash. Nice ending but lacking anything of real excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: These shows seem all so similar. Eyes was decent but no major jams again and certainly no surprises. Long Other One post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: First set lacks some spark, which unfortunatly extends out to the second set as well. Setlist is good but the execution fails.

author: maximinus
summary: Bird Song the best in an average first set. There's some length in the second set but it lacks excitement. Space was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent uptempo first set. Short Dark Star is not the best but nothing bad. Lacks some excitement but overall a nice show.

author: maximinus
summary: An up and down show. Saint of Circumstance doesn't sit well but the start and end is good, with a weird end to Morning Dew.

author: maximinus
summary: Another good uptempo first set. No Bruce. Nice jam out of He's Gone. Dark Star out of drums extends the space. Great Wharf Rat.

author: maximinus
summary: Only an aud for the first set. Long Scarlet Fire. Stunning Estimated end jam. Hamza in drums. Messy last 2 songs though.

author: maximinus
summary: Good first set, and 2nd opens with best China Rider for a long long time. Delightful jam out of He's Gone. End a little flat.

author: maximinus
summary: Holy Moly what a setlist! Funny Vince vocal slip-up. Serious, dense Playin' jam. Terrapin post drums and a rocking end.

author: maximinus
summary: Set list screams awesome. Decent first set with expected jammy Bird Song. Second set is one long party. Best New Years for a while.

author: maximinus
summary: Great version of New Speedway Boogie. Most jammed Crazy Fingers? Killer Black Peter. Whole show is pretty good as a year opener.

author: maximinus
summary: 28 minute Scarlet Fire? Drums > Jam > Space in 2nd set? Jam is unique (good) rapping jam. Very long 2nd set. End a little flat.

author: maximinus
summary: These setlists recently are crazy. 15m Eyes after drums? One of the best year opening runs. Just a little more variety needed.

author: maximinus
summary: Good space. Truckin' > New Speedway Boogie was pretty decent. First ever Rueben & Cherise. Killer Watchtower and Black Peter.

author: maximinus
summary: First set average but pre-drums - especially the Terrapin - jams out pretty well. Baby blue encore was nice except for accordion.

author: maximinus
summary: Really long and decent Eyes to open set 2. Whole is pretty decent, yet another one to add to the run of good 1991 starters.

author: maximinus
summary: Best Victim so far - totally killer. Great jam into Stir It Up. I'm really struggling to critque this show, 1991 is really strong.

author: maximinus
summary: A lot less cheese recently. This is (yet another) great Spring 91 show. Decent Playin' jam and a nice Dew > Saturday Night.

author: maximinus
summary: Laid back or lack of energy in the first set. This extended into the second set and there were no real highlights. Band sound tired.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual jam where Jerry pushes Russian Lullaby after Spoonful but this lacked a bit of energy again. Rare Stones > PITB reprise.

author: maximinus
summary: Vince very annoying on Reuben - just repeating the riff. Long Scarlet Fire but nothing really acheived lift-off. Good Space.

author: maximinus
summary: Very short show, apparently Bobby was pissed off. Jerrys voice lacking power. Very good Terrapin encore improves the score.

author: maximinus
summary: Sound dies in Masterpiece, ending first set early. Second set was decent but workmanlike. Touch Of Grey mini car-crash from Jerry.

author: maximinus
summary: Bruce returns with decent keys. Killer Samson. 23 min Eyes into blistering Playing, even a Star tease there. Great space.

author: maximinus
summary: Proper Dark Star is the real highlight, possibly the second best one of the modern era so far. Rest is decent, with good setlist.

author: maximinus
summary: Average first set. Bit of a comedown from previous shows, even if there was nothing bad. Great Foolish Heart but not much else.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer first set with great setlist. Smoking Help > Slip to start set 2. High energy raver from start to finish. Great show.

author: maximinus
summary: First set starts lively but then eases. Interesting Stir It Up jam post Terrapin. Space is good but post drums lacks excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice end to first set. Short, but decent 2nd Playing jam in second set pre-drums. Space > Box Of Rain? Slightly subdued show.

author: maximinus
summary: Good show from start to finish where the whole is more than the sum of the parts. Good Eyes and Morning Dew in second set.

author: maximinus
summary: End of tour has a relaxed, almost mundane feel to it. Even the 20 min Foolish Heart sailed past me somewhat. Post drums best part.

author: maximinus
summary: First set a bit so-so. Action picks up for second set with a great Playing > Uncle Johns. Great drums. Killer Black Peter again.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice Bird Song with Santana in first set. Deal into drums? Weird space with fruit machines. Nice touches but no standout.

author: maximinus
summary: Fairly decent from the Let It Grow. One of those shows with mellow jamming but no high-energy parts. Enjoyable but measured.

author: maximinus
summary: Very mellow spacy jam out of Victim. Very nice Playin > UJB > Drums. Rock solid set from start to finish, encore was high energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Jamming is decent enough in the second set - almost a Truckin' > Spanish, however Jerry is low in the mix or down on energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry is turned down for sections of set 1. Short but surpisingly powerful Truckin into New Speedway. Rest of show too mellow.

author: maximinus
summary: Nothing too exciting in first set or pre-drums, but space is an ambient thriller. Jerry sounds slighty down in the energy dept.

author: maximinus
summary: Super-long Deal to finish the first set. Another long jam in Terrapin didn't seem to go anywhere. Help > Slip decent. Mixed bag.

author: maximinus
summary: Another really long Deal to end set one. Loving them. Set lists recently have looked jammy on paper but are lacking a bit of meat.

author: maximinus
summary: I'd bet that Jerry is back on the H. Recent shows have become a lot more standard. Best part of this was, yet again, the space.

author: maximinus
summary: Best first set for a while, with a great Stagger Lee. Raging FOTM. Rest of the show not quite as good, apart from SOTM ending.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry turned down too low. Drums / Space is really weird, more like S/D/S with Jerry missing the start. Nothing stood out.

author: maximinus
summary: Best Victim? Short jam but still very good. Unusual Space > Playin' Reprise. This is a bit like last night and could be better.

author: maximinus
summary: Summer is slipping badly compared to the years start. Jerry is turning down. Morning Dew to end is some reasonable compensation.

author: maximinus
summary: First Dark Star for a while, although this one is far too short. Space and encore are great, but could have been a lot more.

author: maximinus
summary: Jack Straw to open the 2nd set! Post drums lacks any real jam, but both the long space and Black Peter post drums jam out.

author: maximinus
summary: First set starts with a 15m Eyes. Dark Star teases everywhere. Uncle John's meltdown excellent. Pretty good show, missing flow.

author: maximinus
summary: Everything pre-drums is normal for the period: saved by the killer Stella Blue > Other One > JBG post drums. Other One is awesome.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent Bird Song. Unusual split Throwing Stones in second set. I enjoyed the messy set list although musically only average.

author: maximinus
summary: Not a bad show. Get this for the fairly decent Playing > Terrapin > D > S > Dark Star > Playing sandwich. Rest is average.

author: maximinus
summary: Also not a bad show. Help > SLip to open set one and the Estimated > Jam > UJB was pretty decent. Also a nice Dew in the 2nd set.

author: maximinus
summary: 32 min Scarlet > Fire! That's mainly the highlight of the show, although Comes A Time out of drums was quite sweet. Average.

author: maximinus
summary: First set not bad, even with Iko Iko in the middle. Have to enjoy the 1 min Star jam in Wharf Rat. Overall, a bit hit and miss.

author: maximinus
summary: Very regular second set setlist. A middling show, but Jerry's singing on Terrapin was unusually enunciated. Otherwise so-so.

author: maximinus
summary: First set was quite alright but the second set felt a bit by the numbers. Not very memorable, even if it wasn't actually bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Short slightly boring first set. Trio of rain songs to start set 2. Crazy Fingers jam is reasonable, rest lacked adventure.

author: maximinus
summary: First set Star! Scarlet > Victim > Fire! This should be a monster show but the Star is lazy and second set under delivers.

author: maximinus
summary: Started well but then the first set got a little messy. Pre-drums so so, but space > Dew > Sat Night was a clear highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual JGB to end first set. Deal to open 3nd set? Stranger > Drums? Weird pre-drums. Stripped back drums and a bit up and down.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer Promised Land to end a decent first set. Long and decent Scarlet > Fire. Loses it's fire and energy after drums.

author: maximinus
summary: A bit too normal for me. Like the mid 80s, filled with 8/9 minutes tracks that never go anywhere. 1991 can be very up and down.

author: maximinus
summary: Setlist looks great on paper. More or less average except for the Terrapin. Not a fan of the short Dark Star jams. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Jam into drums was interesting, even if it was just another 8/9 minute Dark Star tease. Rest of show was more or less average.

author: maximinus
summary: No real stand-outs but the vibe is excellent; the trio pre-drums and the Morning Dew are worth checking. Very solid 1991 show.

author: maximinus
summary: Branford on sax for the whole show. Get for the Help > Slip. Rest is decent but isn't an instant classic. Good not great.

author: maximinus
