summary: Well constructed show, the playing was decent but really lacked a bit of fire. Pre drums have good songs but all too short.

author: maximinus
summary: Best parts are the end of set 1 Bird Song and start of set 2 Victim. Long Scarlet Fire. Nothing wrong, needed more excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Promised Land and Jack Straw, with Bruce giving his all, but the show lacks spark the more further into the show you go.

author: maximinus
summary: Uncle John's into drums and the resulting space were the highlights of a more average than normal 1991 show. Rare Attics as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Rare unusual synth led drums ending (a bit like Vangelis) but this show lacks spark and excitement. Proficient but a bit dull.

author: maximinus
summary: Good first set, and a really good run into drums, especially with the Terrapin. Morning Dew ending is not grade A but a good add.

author: maximinus
summary: Another decent first set. Unique Help > Slip > Fire but nothing interesting in the transition. So What tease in another good space.

author: maximinus
summary: Compentent but lacking excitement. A lot of the randomness of earlier in the year has gone. Eyes are still long versions though.

author: maximinus
summary: Had a decent He's Gone post jam but it sure feels like some of the adventure of earlier in the year has gone. Needs more excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: First Dark Star for a while. Short, and laid back but fairly decent, and leads into a good drums. 2 long Jerry songs after drums?

author: maximinus
summary: Good Terrapin jam, despite missing Jerry. Mind Left Body tease out of space. Great setlist and generally a decent show overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Very mellow and very decent Star to open set 2. There is a lot about this show to like about, especially maybe the flow.

author: maximinus
summary: First show after Bill Grahams death. Absolutly killer first set. Good pre drums jam where Jerry is not the main guitar. Decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Highlight of this show is the reasonably meaty Playin jam into drums. Rest of show is a lot more regular for the period.

author: maximinus
summary: Pretty decent Eyes > Estimated > Terrapin  before drums. The rest of the show is not bad, just not as good as pre-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Short but laid back first set. Kesey rap in Dark Star is raw and chilling. Rest of show is decent but lacks energy near the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Bill Graham Memorial. Popper is good, Fogerty is horribly out of tune, as is Bob in Wharf Rat. Huge show but not that good.

author: maximinus
summary: First set ends nicely. Terrapin jam pre-drums was decent. Best drums of the 90s? They really stand out. Pity about Around x 2.

author: maximinus
summary: Show is wrapped around a split Saturday Night. Really killer first set. Unique Playin > Same thing jam. Best 1991 show by far.

author: maximinus
summary: Great first set with a top quality Bird Song to end. Second set standout Drums / Space with Airto. Vince is great this run.

author: maximinus
summary: Final new years show. Subdued countdown. Nice Estimated > Drums. Nothing really stood out as especially good but a decent show.

author: maximinus
summary: Debut of So May Roads (good) and Wave To The Wind (wtf?). Good (long) drums. Killer Black Peter. Just a little too up and down.

author: maximinus
summary: First versions of Way To Go Home (needs more pep) and Corrina. Great Playin > Terrapin leads to jungle drums. Mix was a bit so-so.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set has all 4 new songs. Jam from starting from rare Other One pre drums is good. Hot drums. Oh shit, Wave to the Wind!

author: maximinus
summary: Less adventurous show, only 34 or so minutes before drums. Nothing particulary bad, just lacked some energy and no decent jams.

author: maximinus
summary: Pretty decent first set. Energy seemed to tail off significantly in the second set. Terrapin had half a jam. Around still sucks.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set Playin' is decent. Best Wave To The Wind so far. Rest of show is pretty average and lacks a lot of energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Unusual Help > Slip > Frank / Same Thing to start set 1. Vocal jam in He's Gone. A lot of energy gone since the new year shows.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob references a computer virus. Keys are too loud but work well on Bird Song. Show is competent but certainly not spectacular.

author: maximinus
summary: New songs are played frequently. Wave To The Wind has a weird potential but falls flat. Best So Many Roads so far. So-so.

author: maximinus
summary: Corrina alomst stops before being jammed into a pretty anonymous Dark Star. Morning Dew mild car crash but Jerry makes up for it.

author: maximinus
summary: It's All Over has strange new start and end. Suprisinglg energetic from end of set 1 with good Terrapin, Last Time and Black Peter.

author: maximinus
summary: Great Sugar Mag ending. Show had some smooth grooves and decent energy, but nothing killer. Playing reprise into drums was unusual.

author: maximinus
summary: Strangly disjointed pre-drum setlist ends with Wave To The Wind. Lacking energy throught the whole show, or is it simply relaxed?

author: maximinus
summary: Great BT Wind ending in first set. A jam comes out of Watchtower because the energy level is low. A pretty weak low energy show.

author: maximinus
summary: Very short 6 song first set. Lacking in any energy pre drums. No immediate highlights, although not particularly terrible.

author: maximinus
summary: "Say your piece and piss off". Vince is way too loud in places. Terrible quality board. Nice set list fails to ignite anywhere.

author: maximinus
summary: Reasonable first set. Decent Shakedown and the Star not too bad. It's pretty good compared to the rest of the Spring tour.

author: maximinus
summary: Good Help > Slip to start the show. Best Terrapin jam for some time. Short show, only 76 minutes for the second set. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Monster Jack Straw to open first set. With the exception of Wave To The Wind, pre drums is good. Best version of Gloria?

author: maximinus
summary: Reasonable Terrapin (which nowadays always seems to have a mini-jam out of). Drums stops midday and insults are exchanged. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set had good energy. Promised Land car crash. Jams are slipping out of the second set now. A little lackluster.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob starts horribly out of tune. 2nd set full of 10 minute songs. Energy there in parts but nothing major. Gloria was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Reminding me of 88 with the lack of any jams. Vince too loud in places, and lacking Jerry. This is competent but lacks excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's guitar is consistently too low and the keys are too high. 3 new 92 shows into drums. Eyes was best of the bunch.

author: maximinus
summary: Why is Vince so loud and Jerry turned down? It kills the shows. Songs also seem too short in second set. Decent Attics though.

author: maximinus
summary: Another low energy show. Phil stays on for the start of drums. Can't help but feel Jerry is using again. Bit of energy at the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice trumpet in Spanish jam. Not a stellar show - jams don't gel again - but it is at least a mild step up from the rest of the month.

author: maximinus
summary: Vince too loud and busy. Second set is again full of shortish songs. Jerry turns off when Steve Miller arrives. Pretty rough.

author: maximinus
summary: Holy smokes I can hear Jerry! Best first set of 1992 so far. Second set keeps most of the energy but fails to dive deep.

author: maximinus
summary: Again Jerry seems up for it. Decent but short first set. Nice Corrina jam and short Star after drums. Best show for a while.

author: maximinus
summary: Vince's solos are crazy loud. Very harsh stereo in drums. Eyes is quite decent, and it's not a bad show, just lacking excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry has definitly turned his volume down for the last few shows. Nice Playin' > Uncle Johns. A little flat post drums space.

author: maximinus
summary: Far too many short songs in the second set, although at least we can still hear Jerry. A bit meh, which is true of too much 92.

author: maximinus
summary: Same post drums as 31/5, also with Steve Miller, but better Jerry. Picasso Moon is 50% Vince. Drums has some sort of drum machine.

author: maximinus
summary: Very good versions of Bird Song and So Many Roads. Drums with drum machine again? Once again with Steve Miller for parts.

author: maximinus
summary: Very long Deal to end first set. Suprisingly jammy Estimated pre drums. Rest of the show is more average, although not anonymous.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice relaxed Eyes in the second set. 6 min Dark Star after drums, a slightly weak Morning Dew + Satisfaction makes for unusual show.

author: maximinus
summary: Good for the era pre-drums selection - jammy and mellow. Steve Miller again (!) but only on the last song. Post drums not as good.

author: maximinus
summary: 4 minute Dark Star into drums kinda sums up the whole of this tour. A splash of Spanish Jam post drums isn't enough to raise the bar.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry shits the bed in Help > Slipknot. Collection of 6 minute songs pre drums. Largely a mixed bag of dissapointment.

author: maximinus
summary: Steve Miller again! Lacks any decent jamming despite some decent guests. Also lacking some energy. So Many Roads was the highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Reasonable first set for a change (and 8 songs!). Decent, albeit short jam in the Playin'. Killer Wharf Rat end. Very decent for 92.

author: maximinus
summary: Help Slip better than the previous time. But songs were quite short and it never broke out to anything major. Mainly underwhelming.

author: maximinus
summary: Reasonable first set with decent So Many Roads. Good drums after fairly anonymous pre-drums. Stella > Sugar Mags is decent ending.

author: maximinus
summary: Vince ruins Picasso Moon. First set a little low on energy but Bird Song good. Fuck me, Steve Miller again. Underwhelming.

author: maximinus
summary: Mickey on congos? Quite like the sound. Makes it sound even less energetic though. Really struggles to gain traction. Bit boring.

author: maximinus
summary: No full soundboard, very unusual this late. Great setlist for set 2. Bob has terrible voice. Reasonable, but had more potential.

author: maximinus
summary: First set aud only. Short pre-drums. Nothing particularly wrong, but like a lot of 92 it really struggles with energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Here Comes Sunshine opener. Actually a decent first set for a change. Messy Samson. Good Playin' Reprise. Loud Weir but decent.

author: maximinus
summary: First set is reasonable, better than earlier in the year but still needs sharpness. Bob out of tune at the end is pretty nasty.

author: maximinus
summary: Garcia nearly loses it in the first set but rallies for great Bird Song. Great jam out of drums starts in Dark Star. Decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice set-list but fails to really catch fire. Post drums pretty short and the Dew failed to really light up. But a decent effort.

author: maximinus
summary: Nice show in the main. Another Dark Star post drums, but this cuts just as it gets good. Bob overrules Jerry at Stella Blue end!

author: maximinus
summary: This is a long show - like a new year! First set was ok. Long show but lacks any lengthy songs. Could do with more HC Sunshine.

author: maximinus
summary: Bird Songs have all been pretty long recently. Very decent Black Peter. Best parts were end of set 1 and start of set 2.

author: maximinus
summary: Shakedown is the most jammy opening to a show in a long while. Rest is not as good. Bobby out of tune pre-drums. Ends with a whimper.

author: maximinus
summary: With Carlos Santana post drums. Setlist looks like there is some major jamming but it turned not to be. Some fun, but not a classic.

author: maximinus
summary: 3 new songs, all a bit slow and lacking energy. This continues throughout the show. Samson > Drums? Subdued for the whole show.

author: maximinus
summary: SBD mix is all over the place, with voices low and Bob high. Improved Wave To The Wind. Days Between was best part of show.

author: maximinus
summary: Last show with Wolf. Best PITB jam for some time. Space onwards with Ornette Coleman. He's good, but a bit wasted on the songs.

author: maximinus
summary: Another good Playing jam. Old school 2nd set setlist. Good Black Peter in the second half. Good show, missing a bit of spark.

author: maximinus
summary: Good versions of 3 new songs into drums. Decent Mind Left Body into drums. Drums onward is relaxed but totally in control.

author: maximinus
summary: Always good to open with Help > Slip! Drums and Space with Ken Nordine. Days Between is a great song. Quite enjoyable.

author: maximinus
summary: First "I fought the law". Jerry forgets Touch Of Grey vocals. These shows are better than 92 but need some more jamming in them.

author: maximinus
summary: Good pre-drums but a short and underwhelming post-drums ruins the mood. Strangly, Morning Dew runs out of steam at the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Only 10 minutes, the Dark Star here actually cut short the excellent Playin' jam. Days Between again very good. LSD encore.

author: maximinus
summary: With Bruce and a little too much accordian at times. Longish Terrapin Jam but nowadays longevity does not always mean much.

author: maximinus
summary: Another long Bird Song. Decent enough, but takes far too long to get to the best parts, which is mainly the high energy end.

author: maximinus
summary: End of space is really good, almost a mini-tiger. Whole show is very decent but lacks some jams, with too many shortish songs.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent Help Slip as the first set starts well and is compentently played, but set 2 does not continue where the first left off.

author: maximinus
summary: Good jam from Crazy Fingers into drums via an almost Playing reprise. Everything after drums is golden, and with a Spanish jam!

author: maximinus
summary: Cracking Dew tops a pretty decent second set. Maybe too many new numbers (Way to go Home after space)? but a decent show overall.

author: maximinus
summary: Final Casey Jones. Whole show is pretty reasonable but lacks any killer moments, although the rare Comes a Time was a highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Fairly normal show eclipsed by the best version of Attics post drums. Rest is fairly reasonable but Heavens Door encore is good.

author: maximinus
summary: Fairly ho-hum show. 1993 so far ebbs and flows. Sometimes great but more often a little so-so. This is one of the latter.

author: maximinus
summary: Playing > Uncle Johns pre-drums was nice, but too short. Long jamming has really gone now. Short post drums but Sugar Mag decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Suffers from bad setlist syndrome, what with Wave to the Wind pre drums and Way To Go Home after. Also lacks a bit of energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's voice a little shot. Another ho hum show, with no obvious standouts. The band can shine in 93, they just don't do it often.

author: maximinus
summary: Midnight Hour opener! Reasonable first set with decent Bird Song closer. Second set was like recent ones, no real surprises.

author: maximinus
summary: Good set list with great Music > Deal ending. Second set list is pretty ropey, and SQ dips terribly. Worst 2nd set for some time.

author: maximinus
summary: A Way To Go Home > Corrina seems to kill the second set pre-drums. Rest is as you'd expect from '93. Less new songs would be good.

author: maximinus
summary: First set has really spacy Bird Song to close with. Argument off stage in drums: "You call that music?!". Actually has jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: The setlist is great, and the playing is fairly decent for 93. Not a bad attempt even though Bobby's voice seems to die at the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Typical 93 gets more typical as the year goes on. Not particularly special bad, but it has many mistakes (Estimated, He's Gone, Dew)

author: maximinus
summary: Like the previous night, the first set is better than the 2nd. Corrina has a reasonable jam. Enjoyable drums and decent Stella Blue.

author: maximinus
summary: Very decent Bird Song. Another very different drums, a bit Vangelis again. Run from Terrapin onwards is decent for the period.

author: maximinus
summary: First set maybe better then the second. Pretty long Eyes opens up the second set but the rest of the set is far less exciting.

author: maximinus
summary: Solid opener. Finally a long meaty jam - likely the best Playing since 1988 or so, and almost on a par with 73 versions.

author: maximinus
summary: Setlist is pretty unusual. Picasso > Fire? Split Cassidy pre drums? Wave to the Wind is actually listenable. Not bad in parts.

author: maximinus
summary: First set not bad, even with Easy answers. Estimated > Drums > Space is all good stuff. Stella Blue is a minor car crash.

author: maximinus
summary: Spectacular car crash in Playin', of all songs. They make up for it in the jam after. Corrina post drums though. Not bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby's voice getting more raspy as the tour continues. Another decent first set. Short but good Terrapin jam. Good Wharf Rat.

author: maximinus
summary: 5 song first set, although has a pretty long 2nd set. Second set starts well but a long Corrina jam sucks the energy out.

author: maximinus
summary: Killer Deal to end first set. Rest of 2nd set was a set of 9 minute songs with minimal jams. Acoustic guitar from Bob for LLR.

author: maximinus
summary: All round not a bad show but no real killer highlights. However, there were no new songs and everything was pleasant enough.

author: maximinus
summary: Don't Ease to end set 1 for 2 shows? Stella Blue and post drums was not too bad but there was a lack of excitement getting there.

author: maximinus
summary: Quite a few radio glitches through the PA. These shows recently feel like "Dead Lite". A decent setlist but lacks the unknown.

author: maximinus
summary: Bob: "Less click please". Really good version of Standing On The Moon. Deal was also decent, rest of show a more usual 1993.

author: maximinus
summary: Best So Many Roads to date. Second sets now are more like first sets with extended drums > space. Around x 2 end is not good.

author: maximinus
summary: Setlist was decent, and that helps a lot this year. Retained some energy up to the encore. Limited exploration spoils things.

author: maximinus
summary: Stunning, aggressive Terrapin jam into drums. Dark Star after drums is more like an appertif. Hunter's birthday, apparently.

author: maximinus
summary: Entire show is with Bruce's accordian?! Bit lacking in jams but made up for in energy. Tails off in the second set. So-so.

author: maximinus
summary: Nothing special until the Playin' jam, which is another decent one. Jam keeps going in Terrapin! Less exciting post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: First show with Lightning bolt. Unusual (for the era) bluesy pre-drums second set. Nice but no real suprises or excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Bit by the numbers, despite that second set Help > Slip opening. Drums / space is getting very long. Could have been more dynamic.

author: maximinus
summary: Terrapin is a little shaky to start but Jerry has great tone and energy for the outro jam. Hard to escape from that 93 vibe though.

author: maximinus
summary: It's a bit mellow and not very jammy but this show had a nice relaxed vibe to it. Around x 2 at the end sucks all the energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Another good Summer 93 Playin'. That and Terrapin are the songs of the year. Bob out of tune for the whole of post-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Not really very exciting, but it does have a killer Morning Dew to close set 2, and that's always a good thing in my book.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set. Second set is again the normal 10 minute songs. Corrina again removes energy. Nice Attics post drums.

author: maximinus
summary: First set was ok but there little of substance here. Seems the band can turn up for a couple of songs but not a whole set.

author: maximinus
summary: Playin' > Dark Star is only 14 minutes? Terrapin jam that follows is much more substantial, and the post isn't too bad either.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry is missing lyrics more often. It's still the Grateful Dead, minus any real surprises and / or jamming of any significance.

author: maximinus
summary: Rain opener. Not terrible but no real fire. The new songs are not that bad but it seems the band can't lean into them enough.

author: maximinus
summary: Another show that is more a collection of songs. Run into drums not too bad. Unusual "That Would Be Something". Very good SOTM.

author: maximinus
summary: Corrina > Drums yet again, feels like a missed oppurtunity. First set was ok but nothing grabbed. At least not many new songs.

author: maximinus
summary: High energy opener starts a decent first set. Good space with singer Edie Brickell. Dew was decent, but no stand-outs.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set. Another PITB > Terrapin in the second set, a fairly decent jam. Lacks fire after D/S though. Needs energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Dave Murray is the best sax player to guest. The jams are short but they sure are spacey. Has to be the show of the year.

author: maximinus
summary: Days Between was decent but the rest of this show was way more middling. Scarlet > Fire was long but really lacking energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Foolish Heart and Corrina have some length but don't really go anywhere. Another I Fought The Law: encores in 93 are bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry plays a different tune in Maggies Farm. He's out of most of the first set. And then he raises the roof with SOTM to close!

author: maximinus
summary: Stumbling over some words is starting to get common for Jerry. Show is normal except for another very beefy Playin pre-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: T. Jed to close first set? Eyes 17 mins? Terrapin 26? Unfortunatly length does not mean excitement, and the jams are just space.

author: maximinus
summary: Post drums Other One had some energy and fizz, rest of show bit more of a doozy. Certainly a consistent show seems beyond them.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent set 2 setlist, although encore terrible as normal. Decent space and an unusual jam into Last Time (which is messed up).

author: maximinus
summary: Drums with Airto and Flora; post drums with Ornette Coleman. They are the best bits, otherwise this show is pretty sub-par.

author: maximinus
summary: Yawn-a-thon show despite the presence of Branford. Nothing is terrible, but there is also zero interaction with the sax player.

author: maximinus
summary: First set was so-so, but second set was overall decent. No real jams but there was a nice flow. Even Truckin' was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Best LSD so far to start 2nd set. Decent Eyes and Days Between. It's not spectacular, but this is a pretty enjoyable show.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry mumbles a song every show. Jerry has new pitchshifter. Screw up in Help leads to decent Slipknot. Struggles for energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Possible longest ever UJB at 23 mins, however the lengthy outro jam lacks fire. Maybe not a classic but very decent for 93.

author: maximinus
summary: Another very long show for the last one of the year. Not a bad show but lacks highlights and Jerry is a bit all over the place.

author: maximinus
summary: No SBD - very rare nowadays. Slow burning gig gets slowly better as it goes. Surprisingly energetic at the end of the show.

author: maximinus
summary: Another AUD. Eyes > Estimated > Terrapin is 49 minutes long! Estimated is decent. Bob does the SOTM solo. Not so bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Infamous 40 second Cosmic Charlie tease. So very cruel. Very good UJB jam. Sombre, MIDI filled space. Rest was solid enough.

author: maximinus
summary: First electric show with Bob playing acoustic? Musically ok but energetically very flat, especially the Throwing Stones end.

author: maximinus
summary: Apparently the last show with soundman Dan Healy. Slightly new up-tempo Stella Blue ending. Rest of show was quite flat though.

author: maximinus
summary: Opens real hot. Good set all the way to Easy Answers. Penultimate - and fast - Dark Star. Nice moments, needed a real highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Early 94 sounds like 93 and possibly better than 92. Decent Playin > Uncle Johns. Surprisingly good Dew to finish the 2nd set.

author: maximinus
summary: Good first set sets up potential decent show but is nullified by lack of energy on the backend. Around x 2 always kills me now.

author: maximinus
summary: Yet another AUD, and not great either. Had some energy in the second set but largely anonymous and the AUD did not help out.

author: maximinus
summary: Car crash at end of Greatest Story. For the era, a killer set list. Monster of a Stella Blue, and best Lovelight since 1972.

author: maximinus
summary: Another decent set list. Show is not as good as the previous night but the Jerry ballads hold up well and energy stays to the end.

author: maximinus
summary: Another AUD, and it's not even a particularly good one. Show lacks cohesion and energy, and no Jerry ballad post drums. Boring.

author: maximinus
summary: And still the AUD's continue, and this pretty bad as well. Hornsby all show, but annoyingly on accordian. Lacklustre show.

author: maximinus
summary: Finally a SBD. Show starts well, dips in the middle but ends with a totally killer Morning Dew. Still, needed cohesion.

author: maximinus
summary: Mainly an AUD again. Unusual GDTRFB into drums. Pretty tame thorughout, although not played badly. Lacks spark and energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Final Dark Star. Classic setlist for the whole second set. Vince lazily does the Pigpen riff. Jams lack any depth or imagination.

author: maximinus
summary: 20 mins for both Eyes and space. 2nd set ends on SOTM. The usual lack of dynamics and jamming for the period, but longer.

author: maximinus
summary: Picasso Moon almost falls apart. Songs now can be long but lacking in adventure. Drums / Space is too long - 31 minutes here!

author: maximinus
summary: Opening Slipknot is a mess. What follows is mainly pretty decent. For 94, this is a good show. Terrapin jam is pretty good.

author: maximinus
summary: Another AUD - not this many since 1979 or so. Also another SOTM 2nd set closer. Rest of show features almost no jamming.

author: maximinus
summary: A 6 song second set - seems the norm. Eyes > Playing > Terrapin either too slow or butchered. Saved partly by the jam into drums.

author: maximinus
summary: The flood of AUDs continue - and this is rough quality. Setlist is a turn off. Even has Around and then IFTL to exit. Not good.

author: maximinus
summary: Another AUD. Many shouts of "Turn it up!". Pretty ropey, Samba In The Rain first time played as well. Jerry wakes up for SOTM.

author: maximinus
summary: AUD seems to be the standard now. Deal is awful. Minor reggae jam after He's Gone. Jerry is sometimes there, sometimes not.

author: maximinus
summary: Of course an AUD. Jerry is sometimes in the uncanny valley. Sugar Mag > Touch interesting. Clunky in places, and uneven throughout.

author: maximinus
summary: This AUD is probably the worst of them all so far, and the show fails to exit. Morning Dew the only saving grace at the very end.

author: maximinus
summary: Finally a SBD. So many modern songs. Not sure what to make of Samba In The Rain. 30 minutes of space! Average for Summer 94.

author: maximinus
summary: First set Jerry is pretty absent. Samba isn't too bad but Jerry does not attack it at all. NFA has a proper stopped ending.

author: maximinus
summary: Not particularly bad but it doesn't inspire in any way. Second set lacks energy throught. Drums and space are getting too long.

author: maximinus
summary: Another 30min+ Scarlet Fire, but it doesn't go anywhere. for the period though, this is the first decent show for quite a while.

author: maximinus
summary: Fairly rough aud considering the time period. Really nothing of excitement here, fluffed lyrics and low energy are everywhere.

author: maximinus
summary: Not a bad show for 94 but tough to really say any of it was of quality. Lack of fire. If The Shoe Fits isn't too bad here.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set is 117 minutes long! It actully has some jamming as well, unfortunatly Jerry doesn't add much and too many mistakes.

author: maximinus
summary: "I Want To Tell You" new cover was fun. Playing jam was semi-decent, leading to a nice drums. On the whole not too bad for 94.

author: maximinus
summary: Has some positives (mainly the setlist and the 2nd set opening Help > Slipknot) but again falls down due to a lack of energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Very short but the first set was ok. Second set has some energy. Drums was killer! Have to say Corrina post drums doesn't work.

author: maximinus
summary: First set one of the best for some time. Show really dies after decent Truckin > New Speedway Boogie. Car crash in US Blues encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Another AUD only. It's like the Grateful Dead, but on mogadon. Really no energy or attack. Drums still ok. Uninspiring.

author: maximinus
summary: Sloppy, uninspired and lacking energy. Also, the audience tape wasn't that great. It's like a really lazy Jerry showing up here.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set with some energy. PITB is quite clearly the jam of the year so far. Lacks energy after drums, but decent enough.

author: maximinus
summary: First Childhoods End. Wtf? First Matilda was also a strange one. Great sounding tape. Good post drums including a rocking JB Goode.

author: maximinus
summary: Help > Slip > Franklins into drums was the highlight of this faiely average 94 show. Low energy is again the mood killer.

author: maximinus
summary: The Playin' > Terrapin jam was pretty reasonable but there's a lack of energy around it. Also, 25 minute space is definitly too long.

author: maximinus
summary: Yet another AUD. Strange set-list, it's like none of the songs have a real flow in set 2. Lot of length, but lacking in fireworks.

author: maximinus
summary: Second set starts with a decent China > Rider. Longest Estimated ever (20 mins). Very decent pre-drums. Really a decent show!

author: maximinus
summary: Some length: Corrina 20m, Days Between 15m, Let It Grow 15m. Nothing much of interest in those sections though. Pretty boring.

author: maximinus
summary: Bobby asks "Eternity?", crowd on AUD says no! First set is largely terrible. Second set is just plain boring mediocrity.

author: maximinus
summary: First set doesn't start well but energy picks up later. For 1994, this was surprisingly high energy, just lacked Jerry solos.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry's last birthday show. Childhoods End is a bad song. The space is one of the best for a long long time. Good post-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Gets slated on archive but maybe for the setlist. It's not great and Jerry mainly fails to show. Foolish Heart was decent enough.

author: maximinus
summary: Yet another AUD. 94 is the worst for this since 78. SQ ain't great and Jerry is mainly MIA. Arguing in the audience as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Another rough aud for the first set. Gets better for the 2nd set. No ballad post drums, but 3 rockers deliver surprising energy.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry has shown up! A reasonable first set and a good Playin' to open set 2. Stella Blue and Baby Blue encore are pretty good.

author: maximinus
summary: Most of this show is pretty average, but the So Many Roads is excellent, although very foreboding. You can sense the end here.

author: maximinus
summary: Seems to be an uptick from Jerry recently, at least I can hear him here. Better than summer, best song is the closing SOTM.

author: maximinus
summary: Whilst these shows are better than Summer 94, that does not say a lot. Even when Jerry shows up, little of excitement happens.

author: maximinus
summary: Not a fan of the pitch bender. Long LiG to finish set one and some jams into drums. Spanish jam was ok but nothing else hit me.

author: maximinus
summary: Long 2nd set - nearly 2 hours! A lot of songs tried something but no real spark was formed, although the Terrapin wasn't bad.

author: maximinus
summary: These current shows are better than summer but all lack some spark. Best of the bunch here is the Truckin' jam and outro.

author: maximinus
summary: First set is not bad and has a good Bird Song. Second set had unusual setlist and managed to be pretty decent for a change.

author: maximinus
summary: This show contains a decent first set, a wide awake Jerry, a serious jam in UJB and drums with Jerry. What a great show for 94!

author: maximinus
summary: Another AUD. Starts similar to previous night, although setlist is worse. High energy at start of 2nd set. Nice pre-drums.

author: maximinus
summary: Yet another AUD. First 2 songs are ok, then it just dies on it's feet. Dew at end of second set helps out just a little.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry goes too early in Saint. Vince is doing more and more solos. Last Comes A Time might be the highlight of a rough show.

author: maximinus
summary: Worst Loose Lucy? It's a shambles. Jerry teeters on screwups quite a few times. Post drums better, except IFTL clunker encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Even these Miller boards aren't great quality. Jerry stays out for drums. Less mistakes than the last few shows at least.

author: maximinus
summary: First set starts well, although Weir's sound is more effect than guitar. Overall this is a decent show, helped by the setlist.

author: maximinus
summary: Very long and pretty decent Scarlet > Fire. Afterwards, dodgy setlist. Jerry is using the pitch shifter too much nowadays.

author: maximinus
summary: These MSG shows are decent for the era. This is like the last few, decent but slight unexciting. Almost no jamming here though.

author: maximinus
summary: A bit up and down but more up than down and the ups are great for 94. Encore with Dylan, "Everyone must get stoned!". Great!

author: maximinus
summary: Good start and first except for mood killer Childhood's End. Rest of show has a reasonable setlist but is devoid of excitement.

author: maximinus
summary: Last ever MSG show. Nice and relaxed first set. Setlist is pretty decent with a long Terrapin. Decent end to the show as well.

author: maximinus
summary: Rough aud. Decent if unusual setlist (Baba O'Riley > TNK > Drums!?). Show was very short. Playing jam was the best part. So-so.

author: maximinus
summary: Another aud. Ticked along in the typical 'bad '94' fashion, almmost no jamming and Jerry low in the mix. Estimated wasn't too bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Aud. Most aud tapes since 1971 or so. Bird Song has some length. Ropey quality, no jamming and Jerry is out of it. Boring.

author: maximinus
summary: Of course another aud, sounding a little distance. Jerry is half there. Largely anonymous, except for the LSD out of Other One.

author: maximinus
summary: A SBD, but Jerry sounds ill and forgets words. Horrible out-of-tune keys at Fire start. 64 mins pre-drums! Not totally shabby.

author: maximinus
summary: Jerry can't play Slipknot but otherwise first set not too bad. Overall not that bad a show for the period, Days Between was good.

author: maximinus
summary: Of course an aud. I would say this was "standard 94" - not a good thing. The Bird Song was decent, rest average. Long 2nd set.

author: maximinus
summary: Oh god, another AUD! More new songs = worse show. Show is also quite short. Bobby on acoustic in space. Not very exciting.

author: maximinus
summary: Last show with Branford. Only first set is aud, thank god. A proper "out there" jam in Estimated. Even post drums is decent.

author: maximinus
summary: A matrix aud, although the quality is iffy. First set is unremarkable. Seems to be a show where the band go through the motions.

author: maximinus
summary: Finally a SBD. 27 minutes of space is far too much! Other than the show is servicable, the highlight being the Days Between.

author: maximinus
summary: First Alabama for a while, although a little slow. Largely upbeat despite that. Quite high energy, this show surprised me a bit.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent first set. Whole show is remarkably decent, even Jerry shows up. Setlist was decent as well. Not a bad start to the year.

author: maximinus
summary: Salt Lake City is fun opener. In fact, best first set for a while. This is most awake Jerry I've heard for some time. Not bad!

author: maximinus
summary: Terrible, boomy audience from 1995. Great. There was a part in SBD and it didn't too bad. But the rest was hard to listen to.

author: maximinus
summary: With Dave Murray. Sounds decent, except that Jerry is largely MIA for most of the show. SBD mix wasn't great. Not terrible.

author: maximinus
summary: Start of 95 seems better than the end of 94. This is average, but that's good for these times. The LSD encore is the best yet.

author: maximinus
summary: Continues decent 95. New cover "All Too Much" is a bit messy, but Playin' jam is best for a while. Excellent visions. Nearly a 4.

author: maximinus
summary: First Unbroken Chain. It's not great but it hangs together just fine. Rest of show lacks risk taking but everyone seems on board.

author: maximinus
summary: Cracking Straw to open with. Energy dies down a bit afterward. Not really a bad show, but a better source would be an improvement.

author: maximinus
summary: Another Unbroken Chain sends the crowd wild, and is also a highlight here. Setlist isn't great, but overall mellow and decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Last High Time. Decent sound board with a hot start. I keep expecting the worst but these shows are all reasonably listenable.

author: maximinus
summary: Another reasonable first set. It's All Too Much is a bit hit and miss. Best Other One for some time. Best 95 show so far.

author: maximinus
summary: Short setlists, long songs. Jerry sounds like he is crying in So Many Roads. Insane Playin > UJB jam. A true 1995 scorcher!

author: maximinus
summary: This spring is perfectly reasonable, and better than all of 94. Weirdly fast Schoolgirl. So-so, although Visions was decent.

author: maximinus
summary: Wind in drums may be the highlight of this show which is far too laid back and lacks excitement. It's not bad, just unexitciting.

author: maximinus
summary: Short but enjoyable first set. Jerry is mainly with us. Overall a reasonable show. Best saved for the Unbroken Chain encore.

author: maximinus
summary: Unfortunatly an audience. Hard to get past that distant sound. A 17min Iko?? This is not a fun listen, largely due to the tape.

author: maximinus
summary: Another Matilda. Not helped by having out of tune Vince. Unexiting, but Jerry is still mostly there and the Dew wasn't too bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Final spring tour show. Long pre-drums. Well played but lacking any energy or creativity. Best, again, was the Unbroken Chain.

author: maximinus
summary: Aud to start the last tour. No dynamics from the tape. Jerry's guitar is just about there for the fills. PITB was not too bad.

author: maximinus
summary: Another aud. Hope to get some SBDs on this tour. Generally poor, low energy and Jerry is missing, expect for the Dew at the end.

author: maximinus
summary: First SBD of the summer tour. The quality certainly helps. Not a terrible show, the Spanish Jam > Other One is the highlight.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent and long Bird Song. Same could be said of the Estimated in the second set. Good show, much better if it was all SBD.

author: maximinus
summary: Unexciting and lacking in energy. The end of drums into start of space was the best, with a slight techno feel. Last Wheel.

author: maximinus
summary: Eternity is not a fun song. Rated by some as show of the year. I don't think so, but it isn't bad for 1995. PITB short but sweet.

author: maximinus
summary: Decent opener, and overall first set is decent. Star hint out of space. As recent shows, largely unexciting but not terrible.

author: maximinus
summary: Everybody's favourite - a summer 95 aud. Actually reasonable quality though, and energy retains itself to the end. Not too bad.

author: maximinus
summary: With the Guyoto Monks. Atonal Bird Song, proper GD. He's Gone jam tries something. Monks are great. The highs are unique and good.

author: maximinus
summary: Another (decent) aud. Please, no more Eternity. Servicable, with no surprises. Setlist is pretty decent, except for the Samba.

author: maximinus
summary: Setlist is pretty decent but nothing is played with any attack. Total train wreck Victim. Thankfully improves a bit after that.

author: maximinus
summary: All the tapes of this show are pretty rough. New cover Rumblin' & Tumblin' is a car crash. Largely lifeless and forgetfull.

author: maximinus
summary: Energy is kinda there for this one; Stagger Lee and China Rider are decent. Jerry messes up Wharf Rat. It's all over the place.

author: maximinus
summary: Never have I ever heard Jerry so low in the mix as this second set. He's literally inaudible. The band battle on somehow. Dreadful.

author: maximinus
summary: Keys out of tune for rough Scarlet > Fire. Saving grace is the final Morning Dew: "I guess it does matter, anyway". Heavy shit.

author: maximinus
summary: Last Help > Slip. Another aud. Horrible MSN as Jerry gives up. Jerry can't play Samba. Long and messy Terrapin. Out of tune in places.

author: maximinus
summary: With Hornsby. He might be the most upbeat player. Jerry sounding sad in So Many Roads. Not that hot. Black Muddy River sums things up.

author: maximinus
summary: Again with Hornsby. Rollin & Tumblin' - either a screw up or a jam. Drums is pretty decent. Not a terrible show. Post drums was fine.

author: maximinus
summary: AUD a little ropey. Long, decent Victim > Foolish jam (30 mins!). More average afterwards. This show really needs a SQ upgrade.
